articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Optimization of Virtual Power Plant Based on Demand Response Potential
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind and photovoltaic power generation and energy storage systems on the user side, the power system can no longer directly manage massive distributed resources (DER), but the huge response potential under multi-agent aggregation can not be ignored. In this background, this paper first analyzes the demand response potential of distributed resources of source, load and storage, and then introduces virtual power plant (VPP) technology to centrally manage and adjust massive heterogeneous distributed resources in adjacent geographical locations, and establishes a VPP optimal scheduling model based on the hierarchical management architecture of cloud edge. Then, the aggregation characteristics and response potential of virtual power plants under the large-scale access scenario of various types of distributed resources are studied. Finally, the basic data of four typical VPP with different resource aggregation characteristics are selected for example analysis, and two comparative scenarios are set up: independent operation and participation in power system demand response. The simulation results verify the market value of virtual power plants in terms of resource integration and efficiency enhancement.

articleTitle: Delay-Tolerant Voltage Restoration Control of Microgrids with Multiplicative Noises
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In practical microgrids based on distributed gen-eration technologies, communication among distributed gener-ators (DGs) is affected by noises and communication delays. Moreover, as communication delays are not constant and vary over time, overcoming the influence of noise and time-varying delays is crucial. Therefore, this study investigates the delay tolerance issue of microgrid voltage control under multiplicative noises environments. Subsequently, a voltage consensus controller is designed for secondary control. By employing appropriate control gain design and linear growth conditions, delay bounds under the significance of mean square exponential stability are obtained. Finally, the proposed method's effectiveness is demonstrated through simulations carried out using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Control Method of Permanent Magnet Wind Power Generation System Based on Midpoint Potential Balance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The three-level NPC type converter is widely used in high-voltage and high-power applications due to its simple structure and high output power quality. It is currently the main-stream three-level topology. However, due to the presence of the midpoint of the DC side capacitor, the three-level converter topology may cause the midpoint potential of the capacitor to shift and fluctuate when it is at zero level in the switching state, leading to over-voltage risks in the switching devices and supporting capacitors, Therefore, it is necessary to suppress the offset and fluctuation of the midpoint potential on the DC side. This paper proposes a midpoint potential balance control method that integrates vector modulation factor and vector group selection to effectively suppress midpoint potential fluctuations, thereby improving the stability and safety of inverter operation.

articleTitle: Optimized Scheduling for Zero-Carbon Eco-Parks with Biomass Units Peaking Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Biomass energy is an abundant renewable energy source, but currently biomass combined heat and power (CHP) units have a strong thermal-electric coupling and limited flexibility. This leads to increased curtailment rates for other new energy sources. To address the aforementioned issues, this study establishes a zero-carbon energy system incorporating electric heat pumps, thermal storage tanks, energy storage, biomass combined heat and power (CHP) units, and the integration of wind and photovoltaic units. A two-tiered optimization scheduling model is devised, with the upper tier minimizing the variance of net load fluctuations and the lower tier minimizing the operational costs of the biomass CHP system. Four distinct scenarios are designed for comparative analysis. The commercial solvers CPLEX and YALMIP toolbox in MATLAB were employed to solve the problem. The final results indicate that the established model successfully reduces net load fluctuations, mitigates the curtailment of renewable energy, lowers the overall operational costs of the system, and promotes the economic integration of new energy sources.

articleTitle: Adaptive Event-Triggered Control of Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach to address the problem of multi-agent collaboration, namely an event-triggered control strategy. What sets this method apart is its independence from global information of a directed communication network and its lack of reliance on boundary factors of faults, rendering it operable without centralized control. Each agent only needs to be aware of relative information among its neighbors, thus ensuring complete decentralization. In addition, a new consensus error conversion mechanism has been proposed to achieve discrete communication among intelligent agents.

articleTitle: Scalable Fault-Tolerant Control of Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of fault-tolerant coordinated control in multi-agent systems (MASs), where actuators may suffer from partial loss of effectiveness (PLOE) faults and bias faults. The proposed strategy ensure continued coordination among the agents. One noteworthy aspect of this protocol is that control is achieved based on relative information with neighbors, independent of global information communicated over the network. Additionally, this strategy is scalable.

articleTitle: Optimal Cruising Control for Unmanned Surface Vehicles Under the Sea Area Exploration Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The optimal cruising problem for multi-USVs under the sea area exploration tasks is investigated in this paper. Firstly, the optimal cruising issue can be viewed as the optimal trajectory tracking control problem, and a distributed optimal trajectory tracking control scheme is proposed, wherein each local cost function is encoded in the global cost function, characterizing the tracking performance of the systems. Then based on Lyapunov analysis, it is proven that the tracking errors can asymptotically converge to zero, and the cost function can attain its minimal value. Finally, simulation results illustrate the efficiency of the devised cruising methods by tracking the spiral lines to expand the exploration area, where all USVs can track the given trajectories while maintaining minimal cost functions.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Network for Sign Detection on Radiographic Weld Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Weld signs contain a great deal of information related to pipe welds. Realizing efficient sign detection is crucial to weld quality assessment. Existing two-stage algorithms have achieved high accuracy in sign detection, however, higher speed is also required in practical engineering. In order to detect signs more efficiently, we propose an end-to-end sign detection method based on one-stage object detection framework. Firstly, an improved global feature pyramid network TGFPN based on triple feature encoder (TFE) is proposed for comprehensively fusing global feature maps. On the other hand, a light-weight backbone is proposed for efficiently encoding feature maps. Compared with other existing SOTA methods, the proposed method outperforms more efficiently(5.9M) and more effectively(0.942mAP) on practical industrial Images.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Scheduling of Multi-port Energy Router Based on Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Energy router is the key equipment for coordinated management and efficient utilization of multiple energy sources in the energy Internet. This article proposes an efficient energy optimization scheduling method (SSA-PSO) to address the issues of low distributed energy utilization efficiency and unreasonable energy configuration among the ports of energy routers. Firstly, introduce the physical layer, information layer, and energy management system architecture of the energy router. Introduce the topology structure. Secondly, establish a multi-objective optimization scheduling model under grid connection mode that comprehensively considers the operating costs and environmental protection costs of multi port energy routers, and then solve the optimization model through an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, comparing SSA-PSO with traditional PSO, simulation results show that the proposed method has better convergence accuracy, stronger global search ability, and superior performance in the field of energy router optimization scheduling.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Improvement of Distribution System Resilience under Damage Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Events of high impact but low frequency such as wars and extreme weather are likely to cause cluster dis-connection of the distribution network and even large-scale power outages, which will have a negative impact on economic development and social stability. In this context, firstly, two uni-versal network resilience evaluation indexes, load configuration redundancy and balance of communication network is proposed. Then, the graph theory is used, considering the interaction of communication network and power grid, to abstract network topology model, the genetic algorithm and K-Shell algorithm are innovatively combined to optimize the load configuration of the communication network topology. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Decoupled Control of the Split-Capacitor Midpoint-Clamped Three-Phase Four-Leg Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The split-capacitor midpoint-clamped three-phase four-leg (3P4L) inverter is capable of sustaining stable output with three-phase symmetrical voltages under both balanced/unbalanced and linear/non-linear loads. This topology achieves the clamping of the neutral point of the three-phase load at V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dc</inf>/2 by controlling the fourth leg, thus separating the control of the fourth leg from that of the preceding three legs and achieving their decoupling at the topology level. This article treats the preceding three legs and the three-phase load as an equivalent controlled current source and employs state-space averaging to derive the small-signal AC equivalent circuit of the fourth leg. Addressing the coupling relationship within the fourth leg's small signals, an approximate decoupling control strategy is proposed based on the small-signal equivalent model of the fourth leg. By introducing a virtual impedance via an inner loop controller, the coupling strength within the fourth leg is decreased, achieving approximate decoupling of the fourth leg control. Furthermore, this method approximately separates the AC voltage small signals into two independent channels in the dq coordinate system, facilitating the design of closed-loop parameters. Finally, simulation verifies the proposed strategy, demonstrating that under this topology, symmetrical three-phase voltages can be outputted for any load under the control of this decoupling strategy.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Dual-Branch Multi-Scale CNN-LSTM Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The condition detection and fault diagnosis of bearings are the basis for the smooth operation of rotating machinery. Since the traditional convolutional neural network cannot make full use of the time correlation of the original signal and it is difficult to obtain enough training data under multiple working conditions, this paper proposes a CNN-LSTM fault diagnosis method based on dual-branch multi-scale feature fusion (DMCNN-LSTM). Without any preprocessing and traditional feature extraction, the original vibration signal is directly used as the input of the model, and a two-branch convolutional neural network with different kernel sizes is established. The system can autonomously learn features from the unprocessed data stream. The long short-term memory is then used to identify fault types based on the learned features. The method is verified in the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) dataset, and the proposed method can achieve an average accuracy of 99.867% and show robustness in parameter changes. Compared with deep neural network (DNN), long short-term memory (LSTM), and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithms, DMCNN-LSTM has better performance under common fault conditions, which provides a scalable and efficient solution for industrial applications.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Speed Control Method of Backstepping Nonsingular Terminal Based on In-Pipe Detector
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Stable operating speed is a prerequisite for detecting defects in the pipeline detector. This article establishes a mathematical model of an in-pipe detector based on butterfly valves, and uses a backstepping non singular terminal sliding mode controller based on an extended state observer to achieve speed control of the in-pipe detector. Firstly, a dynamic model of the velocity controller for the detector inside the butterfly valve tube is proposed, which has the characteristic of real-time variation of valve area over time. Finally, a BNTSM controller was designed to control the speed of the detector in the pipeline. The results show that the designed BNTSM speed controller has certain robustness and universality, and can stably track the expected speed of the detector in the pipeline. This design is reasonable and effective, meeting the requirements of object detection, and has reference significance for subsequent research on the speed regulation of detectors in pipelines.

articleTitle: A Robust PID-Based Adaptive Fixed-Time Control for Nonsmooth Uncertain Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The article shows that the PID method is introduced to solve the robust adaptive fixed-time control trouble of non-smooth uncertain systems. For handling nonsmooth uncertain functions existing in the considered system, an assumption is given to handle them. Furthermore, by integrating the self-tuning gain PID way, an actual controller is proposed. Stability analysis and the simulation show the availability for the obtained control way.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Model Predictive Control Strategy for Coagulant Dosing in Water Treatment Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Traditional control methods for the coagulation process in water treatment plants are often inefficient and costly. In this paper, a data-driven coagulant dosage prediction model is introduced using an optimization framework based on genetic algorithm (GA) improved fuzzy C-means clustering (FCM) and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), which can be adapted to the dynamic changes of raw water quality. Through model predictive control (MPC), a multi-objective controller is designed for determining the coagulant dosage set point and control law, integrating optimization and control. After MATLAB/Simulink simulation and practical application in water treatment plants, the method was shown to have significant advantages in cost reduction and water quality stabilization, confirming its potential for coagulant dosage control in water treatment setups.

articleTitle: The Optimization Research of Integrated Energy System with Wind and Solar Based on Nutcracker Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the increasing demand for energy and the depletion of energy resources, the optimization of integrated energy systems has become the key to solving the challenges between energy supply and environmental protection. This paper mainly aims at the optimization of the integrated energy system with wind and cold, heat and power generation. Firstly, a comprehensive energy system mathematical model considering the uncertainty of the landscape is constructed. Secondly, the design considers the objective functions and constraints of the economy, safety and environmental protection of energy use. Thirdly, the optimization of the integrated energy system is realized by using the algorithm of Nutcracker Optimization optimization. Finally, a comprehensive energy system park in the southeast coast is taken as an example to carry out simulation verification. The simulation results show that under the condition of constant output value, the annual theoretical energy consumption cost can be reduced by 3.24 percentage points, carbon emissions can be reduced by 65,142.5 kg, and 26.48 tons of standard coal can be saved. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm was verified.

articleTitle: Flexible Resource Aggregation Model and Scheduling for Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To solve the problem that the power load difference between peak and valley is large and the conventional unit can not meet the demand of peak load balancing, this paper presents a virtual power plant optimization scheduling method which integrates electric vehicles and air conditioning equipment. Considering the coupling characteristics of different types of loads in time and space, the optimal scheduling model of electric vehicle and air conditioning equipment including the participation of virtual power plant was established. Factors such as renewable energy, storage battery capacity and load are included in the objective function. The electric vehicle model considers its travel law and charge and discharge law, which is more in line with the actual situation. The air conditioning system also considers the demand response regulation of load, and adopts the principle of thermodynamics and conservation of energy to implement the optimal energy consumption curve control strategy for the air conditioning unit. The effectiveness of the proposed model and method is verified by MATLAB simulation. It can effectively reduce the operating cost of virtual power plant and provide a new way to improve the efficiency of virtual power plant.

articleTitle: Safety Management and Control Technology of Explosives in Infrastructure Engineering of a Super Large Underground Iron Mine
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The construction period of infrastructure in extra-large underground mines often entails prolonged durations, arduous tasks, multiple blasting units, intricate personnel arrangements, high frequencies of blasting, and substantial consumption of explosives. Shougang Luannan Macheng iron mine serves as an exemplar of such a mine with 12 main and auxiliary shafts, ventilation shafts, and simultaneous ramp construction. Considering the specific conditions for blasting during the construction phase, a comprehensive management and control system has been developed and implemented. This closed-loop system strictly regulates all aspects related to explosives including procurement, transportation, storage, issuance, usage monitoring, return procedures as well as disposal processes. By employing advanced technologies such as video surveillance cameras for recording purposes along with individual equipment monitoring systems and explosive detection instruments integrated into the civil explosion safety supervision platform; effective control over explosives has been achieved resulting in outstanding safety records while also contributing to social welfare and economic benefits. This approach holds significant guidance value for managing explosives in similar mining infrastructure projects.

articleTitle: Stabilizing of Nonlinear Singular Hamiltonian Systems with Actuator Saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The stability problems of nonlinear singular Hamiltonian systems with actuator saturation is studied in this paper. The nonlinear singular Hamiltonian system will be first converted into a strictly dissipative Hamiltonian form by means of an equivalent transformation with suitable state feedback. Next, the stability problem of the system is investigated and a controller is designed based on this form. Finally, an example of a nonlinear singular Hamiltonian system with actuator saturation is given, and the effectiveness of the controller is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Induction Motor Bearing Based on DACNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The fault signal of induction motor with rolling bearing fault will change with the change of load, which will lead to the change of fault characteristic distribution and affect the accuracy of fault diagnosis. The generation of noise signal may make important fault information submerged, so it is difficult to extract fault characteristics, and then affect the accuracy of fault diagnosis. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method of induction motor bearing based on one-dimensional convolutional neural network model in deep learning, and focuses on solving the problem of accurate fault diagnosis of induction motor bearing under load change and noise interference conditions. The experimental results show that the diagnostic accuracy of the proposed model is 97.3% on average under variable load. Under the condition of variable load and noise interference with different signal-to-noise ratio, the diagnostic accuracy of the model reaches 93.8% on average, which indicates that the model has good adaptive ability and anti-noise performance under variable load.

articleTitle: An Auxiliary Decision-Making Method for Distributed Resources Under Load Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The Distributed Resources (DRs) facilitate optimal utilization of renewables, reduce transmission losses, and improve system flexibility. However, the economic benefit of DRs is affected to a certain extent by load uncertainty. To address it, an auxiliary decision-making method considering load uncertainty is proposed to enhance reliability and economics. First, a basic framework of DRs is constructed, and the mathematical models of the electricity, heat, and gas systems, as well as relevant energy equipment, are analyzed, providing a theoretical basis for optimizing the operation of DRs. Then, an auxiliary decision-making model for DRs is proposed to reduce load uncertainty and improve the efficiency and reliability of the energy system. Finally, the load of electric vehicle charging stations is considered, and optimization is performed based on seasonal factors. Case study results confirm the feasibility and economic viability of this optimization approach.

articleTitle: Dynamic State Estimation of AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Model Compensation and Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The measurement errors in AC/DC hybrid distribution networks can introduce biases in state estimation results, thereby affecting the misalignment of local control units such as converters and compromising system stability. Additionally, the uncertainty of renewable energy sources renders the current dynamic state estimation based on mean square error assumptions no longer applicable. To address these issues, this paper proposes an Interpolation Compensated Unscented Kalman Filtering (ICUKF) algorithm, which eliminates control signal noise in complex scenarios to achieve stable control. The proposed algorithm adds pseudo-measurement data between two consecutive sampling points according to the interpolation factor, thereby shortening the sampling step size and reducing the discretization error. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method exhibits higher robustness and stable estimation performance in complex noise and adverse data conditions.

articleTitle: Offensive and Defensive Strategy for Distribution Network CPS Considering EV Source-charge Bidirectional
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The modern power system has developed into a cyber-physical system(CPS) in which power and information networks are highly interpenetrating. However, along with the large-scale grid integration of Electric Vehicles(EV), the modern power system's ability to consume new energy has been greatly increased while further reducing the network security of the distribution network. On this basis, this paper firstly proposes a distributed energy management strategy based on the consistency algorithm, which regards EV clusters as energy storage devices with source-charge bidirectional characteristics. Considering false data injection(FDI) attack, a control strategy based on prestige value isolation is proposed to achieve the energy management of the system under cyber attack. Finally, the feasibility of the control strategy is verified by arithmetic simulation.

articleTitle: Small Target Detection Based on Multimodal Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In view of the problems of large amount of computation, slow detection speed and low accuracy brought about by the current small target detection algorithm through complex deep neural network to learn the strong feature representation of the target separated from the background, an improved YOLOv5s algorithm YOLOv5y is proposed, which first fuses multimodal data. Then, by removing the Focus module to build a compact model to maintain the HR characteristics. Subsequently, a C3-T module was designed to replace the C3 module to obtain richer gradient flow information. The L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CIoU</inf>is replaced by the LCNWD loss function that is not sensitive to the target size to solve the problem that the IoU measurement method is sensitive to the target size. Experiments and analysis on the VEDAI remote sensing dataset show that compared with the baseline framework YOLOv5s, the mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>is improved by 14.04% without a significant increase in the amount of computation, achieving a balance between accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: A Simple Method to Synthesize ZIF-9 Metal-Organic Framework-Derived Co3o4 as Electrode Material for Supercapacitor
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In this paper, a unique structure with an outer porous block and an inner layered “house-like” structure was prepared through the low-temperature thermal decomposition of bulk ZIF-9. This structure effectively prevents accumulation and greatly increases the specific surface area. The porous structure also ensures full contact between the electrode material and the electrolyte, thereby accelerating the ion transfer rate. This study investigated the morphology and properties of the materials formed at different calcination temperatures. At a current density of 1A/g, the electrode synthesized at 300°C exhibited the highest specific capacity of 438Fig. The prepared symmetric supercapacitor demonstrated a capacitance retention rate of 81.6% after 3500 cycles at a current density of 1A/g. Additionally, devices connected in series were able to light up a red LED for 3 minutes. The results indicate that the ZIF-derived material prepared by this method is a highly attractive candidate for supercapacitor applications and provides a new scheme for the synthesis of MOF-derived electrode materials.

articleTitle: One-time Shaping Controlled Blasting on the Ultra-thick Diaphragm Wall of a Large Rotary Railcar Dumper Room by Slotting and Presplitting
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Based on the theory of precision blasting and taking into account the characteristics of the special engineering structure and the surrounding environment, a reasonable blasting scheme of one-time shaping-controlled blasting by slot cutting and presplitting was selected through comparison with different blasting options. This scheme alters the conventional blasting demolition technique of intermediate slot cutting. Instead, it adopts a method of slot cutting at the bottom and downward trapezoidal initiation. Through precise calculations, reasonable blasting technical parameters are determined. Its implementation is successful for the controlled blasting of the circular ultra-thick reinforced concrete diaphragm wall, which is located in the Caofeidian Port Area of Tangshan, creating large hole openings. The blasting achieves excellent results and economic benefits, providing guidance for similar engineering projects.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Storage Control Strategy of Energy Router Based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To mitigate the impact of factors such as fluctuations in photovoltaic output power and load switching on the voltage of the DC bus, and to enhance the anti-interference capability and response speed of the energy router system, this paper proposes an energy router energy storage converter control strategy based on linear active disturbance rejection control. By designing a linear state error feedback control law and a linear extended state observer to estimate the total disturbance in real-time, adjusting the parameters of the controller using bandwidth method, and then controlling the voltage outer loop of the energy storage converter. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the controller are verified through simulation results.

articleTitle: A Comparison Study of the Energy-Saving Effectiveness of Envelope Retrofits in Public Building in Cold Climate Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper takes an existing library building in Liaoyuan, Jilin, China, as the study object, conducts simulations and analyses of the building envelope energy consumption, and proposes an energy-saving plan tailored for retrofitting the envelopes of existing public buildings in cold climate regions. The aim is to enhance energy efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and provide a reference for future retrofit studies and designs in similar contexts.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Event-Based Course-Keeping Control of Marine Vessel
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of course keeping control for marine vessel with limited communication band-width, unknown environment interference and model uncertainty. Firstly, for the Nomoto nonlinear model of marine vessel, the Backstepping method is used to deduce the course-keeping controller. By using the event-triggered condition, the rudder angle command is transmitted only when the condition is met, which can reduce the steering frequency of the rudder equipment. By taking advantage of radial basis neural networks (RBF-NN), unknown system terms and external disturbances can be compressed into an unknown parameter, and only one adaptive law needs to be updated online. Through Lyapunov analysis, it is proved that all tracking errors of the closed-loop system are globally consistent and finally bounded. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Global Consensus of Multi-agent Systems with Unknown Input Delay and State Delay by the Switching Predictor Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The consensus problem for the linear time-invariant multi-agent systems (MAS) with the input delay and the state delay is investigated. First, we divide the bound of the unknown input delay into subintervals as an estimate of it. Then, a controller is designed based on the input delay estimator to achieve the cooperative goal. Second, using Lyapunov function, a logic-based switching mechanism is proposed to make the input delay estimator sufficiently close to the true delay. Finally, A numerical example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed controller and switching mechanism.

articleTitle: Distributed Secondary Control Strategy with Dynamic Event Triggering for Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Distributed control has received more and more attention in microgrid secondary control. However, the traditional control method requires periodic communication between different communication units, which often causes excessive communication burden and reduces economic benefits. In this paper, a distributed quadratic control scheme using dynamic event-triggered protocol is proposed, and an effective algorithm is given to select event-triggered control parameters and Zeno-free trigger parameters, which can achieve frequency recovery, reduce the deviation of voltage amplitude from the standard value, and accurately share the active and reactive power. With the dynamic event-triggered strategy, the reset of pairwise estimates can be achieved only at the time of event triggering. The proposed distributed controller only needs to communicate at these specific moments. The proposed controller can be implemented so that it is fully distributed, meaning that each control unit only needs and obtains information between itself and its neighbors. Finally, an island microgrid test system is constructed in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Neuroadaptive Trajectory Tracking Control for an Underwater Robot via Backstepping Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Underwater robots (URs) are specialized extreme operating robots designed for underwater operations. Due to the harsh underwater environment and the limited diving depth of humans, URs have become crucial tools for ocean development. They can perform tasks such as underwater monitoring, rescue, and operations through remote control or autonomous means, playing a significant role in ocean exploration, resource development, and scientific research. This article studies the problem of neuroadaptive trajectory tracking control for a UR. For the purpose of achieving the precise tracking control, the neural network technology is used to address the unknown nonlinearities. Using the backstepping method, a neuroadaptive control strategy is developed, that resolves the problem of unknown dynamics of the UR. It can be proven that on the basis of the presented actual neuroadaptive control law, both the precise tracking and the boundedness of closed-loop signals are ensured. Simulation results on the UR system testify the effectiveness of the developed control scheme.

articleTitle: Adaptive Optimized Tracking Control of an Autonomous Marine Vehicle with Actuator Faults
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This article studies the problem of adaptive optimized fault-tolerant tracking control for an autonomous marine vehicle subject to actuator faults. By proposing a novel optimized backstepping strategy, the optimal controllers at the kinematic and kinetic levels are derived. Different from the existing optimized backstepping strategies with the case of actuator health, the unknown control rate and the gradient of the optimal performance index function are viewed as a unified whole to derive the available optimal controllers at the kinetic level. In Lyapunov stability analysis, the designed optimal controller can be contaminated by the unknown parameters of actuator faults, which cannot ensure the boundedness of the closed-loop system. To overcome this difficulty, an actual adaptive fault-tolerant controller is designed to effectively compensate for actuator faults. Finally, the effectiveness of the presented method is demonstrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch of Urban Renewable Energy Based on Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: As renewable energy sources increase, the economic dispatch problem faces challenges in modeling and solving equipment operating costs. In this paper, an improved renewable energy cost function using the principle of maximum information entropy, confidence intervals and penalty factors, and considering uncertainty to model the operating cost of renewable energy. Further, we design a fully distributed Newton descent optimization algorithm. The algorithm achieves fast second-order convergence to ensure a fast solution of the economic dispatch problem and overcomes the asymmetry induced by directed communication networks. In addition, this chapter gives a theoretical proof of the optimality of the distributed Newton descent optimization algorithm. Finally, simulations and experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Considering Topology Recognition for Pseudo-Measurement Generation in Low-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To improve the precision of pseudo-measurement generation in low-voltage distribution networks, this paper considers the use of graph neural networks that utilize topological relationships. However, issues such as the unavailability of topology data in some areas and incorrect topology configurations impact the quality of the generated pseudo-measurement data. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a pseudo-measurement generation method that considers topology identification for low-voltage distribution networks. The proposed method leverages graph neural networks, which are capable of aggregating information and dependencies from key voltage and power measurements. Additionally, we integrate recurrent neural networks to capture the temporal dynamics of the distribution networks, thereby enhancing the model's ability to handle data that varies over time. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated through simulations on a 14-node low-voltage distribution network, showcasing its potential in practical applications.

articleTitle: Consideration of Low-Carbon Dispatching of Electrothermal Systems for Ultra-Supercritical Power Plants with Carbon Capture
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a low-carbon scheduling method for the electric heating system of a carbon capture ultra supercritical power plant that considers comprehensive and flexible operation, in response to the carbon emissions and difficulties in new energy consumption caused by the “electric thermal coupling” of traditional cogeneration units during operation. First, adding carbon capture equipment to the ultra-supercritical unit allows the system to capture and store CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> generated by coal burning in the boiler, while using electric boilers and heat storage devices to provide auxiliary heat. Secondly, using ultra-supercritical The high flexibility of the unit forms a power plant equipped with carbon capture technology operates with a broad and adaptable approach. and then coordinates with the wind power, so that it can complement the electric energy generated by the wind farm, complete the consumption of wind power, and ensure the low-carbon operation of the integrated energy system. Finally, through case simulation, the effectiveness of the proposed model in low-carbon emission reduction and wind power consumption was verified.

articleTitle: Fast Topology Identification of AC / DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Mixed Integer Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Topology identification is crucial for advanced analysis such as state estimation in hybrid AC/DC distribution networks. Traditional topology identification methods based on data statistics lack accuracy, and optimization-based methods exhibit low efficiency. To address these issues, a topology identification method based on mixed-integer linear programming is proposed. Initially, the normalized Lagrange multiplier is utilized to identify suspicious measurements, forming a set of suspicious measurements to reduce the number of integer variables to be determined. Subsequently, a linearization method for network constraints in hybrid AC/DC distribution networks is introduced to transform the topology identification problem into a mixed-integer linear programming model. The simulation results demonstrate that by constructing a set of suspicious measurements and linearizing network constraints, the efficiency of solving the problem is significantly improved while ensuring the accuracy of identification.

articleTitle: Event-Driven Control of Multi-Agent Systems Based on Discrete Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: A new control strategy for tracking multiple agents is proposed, utilizing discrete communication methods. This strategy incorporates adaptive techniques to minimize reliance on global information and implements event-driven mechanisms for discrete measurements between neighboring agent. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of this strategy in regulating load voltage.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of Big Data Technology in the Management of Electric Power Safety Production
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the power industry and the continuous growth of power demand, power production safety management has become a key link to ensure the stable operation of the power system and safeguard people's lives and property. In the face of the increasingly complex power system and changing operating environment, the traditional production safety management has been difficult to meet the needs of the modern power industry. Therefore, based on big data technology, this paper conducts an in-depth study on the application of electric power production safety management, aiming to improve the efficiency and reliability of electric power production safety management through a data-driven approach. By collecting, analyzing and applying big data in the electric power industry, it discusses how to use big data technology to improve the efficiency and reliability of electric power safety production management. At the same time, the specific applications of big data in various aspects of electric power production safety management, including risk assessment, early warning monitoring, and decision support, are discussed in the context of practical cases, and relevant management methods and technical means are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling Strategy of Virtual Power Plant Multi-Operation Scenarios Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The uncertainty in the prediction of renewable energy generation and power load brings great challenges to the safe and economic operation of virtual power plant (VPP), and a robust VPP optimization scheduling method is urgently needed. Traditional robust optimization scheduling methods are conservative in selecting the uncertain condition set, which makes it difficult to effectively reduce the operation cost of VPP. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-scenario optimal scheduling method for VPP based on deep reinforcement learning. First, renewable energy generation characteristic indexes are designed, and condition generation adversarial network is used to generate various operation scenario data of renewable energy. Second, the VPP optimal scheduling model is constructed and transformed into a deep reinforcement learning model, and the action space, state space and reward function are reasonably designed. Finally, the Soft Actor-Critic algorithm is used to solve the nonlinear and nonconvex problem to obtain the robust economic scheduling strategy. Experiments show that the proposed economic scheduling strategy is robust and can be adapted to a variety of operating scenarios of VPP, effectively reducing the operating cost of VPP.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Resilient Control Based on False Data Injection Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The paper introduces a resilient control method for nonlinear multi-agent systems (MAS). The attack type considered in this paper is FDI (False Data Injection) attacks targeting the controller. The consequence of the attack is the occurrence of controller malfunction. In industrial control systems, FDI attacks pose a significant security threat. Instead of relying on global information about the communication network, this method allows agents to exchange information locally with their neighboring agents. Each agent has its own control mechanism, which helps avoid the need for centralized communication. Furthermore, this approach addresses the issue of elastic control in the presence of FDI attacks. It ensures that the system can continue to operate smoothly even when encountering unknown abnormal parameters. By carefully selecting Lyapunov functions, the paper demonstrates that the system achieves stable consensus between leaders and followers in a multi-agent setting.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Management System in Electric Vehicles Based on Model Predictive Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the development and progress of science and technology, microgrids have attracted extensive attention from industry players because of their broad development prospects, and also the energy management system in microgrids has been rapidly developed. Due to the intermittent and fluctuating characteristics of distributed power in microgrids, it will lead to the instability of system power supply and distribution. In order to better solve this problem, a model predictive control (MPC) strategy based on parameter sharing mechanism is proposed. The traditional MPC produces large errors when dealing with sudden disturbances, which affects the stability and robustness of the whole system; and the traditional MPC is difficult to obtain real-time control results because of the long optimisation intervals, so it is difficult to design the feedback link, which results in the predicted values being far away from the actual values. To address the shortcomings of the traditional MPC, the preferred depth deterministic gradient algorithm with parameter sharing is proposed to be applied to the improved model predictive control strategy, which improves the accuracy of the calculation results and accelerates the calculation efficiency. Finally, MATLAB is applied for simulation to prove the accuracy of the proposed strategy.

Author Keywords: priority depth deterministic policy gradient algorithm

articleTitle: Research on Neural Network-Based Intelligent Recommendation Algorithm for Electricity Etail Packages
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the popularisation of the Internet, the electricity retail market is facing new opportunities and challenges. Electricity market retail packages currently suffer from the lack of personalisation, information asymmetry, and difficulties in updating packages. The aim of this paper is to investigate a neural network-based intelligent recommendation algorithm for electricity retail packages to improve user experience and enhance market competitiveness. In this study, several features are used as inputs to the neural network, including users' historical electricity consumption data, market environment data and personal information. By training the neural network model, the user's future electricity consumption behaviour can be predicted and the most suitable package can be recommended for them. In the experiments, a comparison with traditional recommendation algorithms is made, and the results show that the LSTM neural network-based algorithm has advantages in the metrics of recommendation accuracy, RMSE, MSE and MAE. With this algorithm, users can get accurate and efficient personalised package recommendations.

articleTitle: Research on Data-Driven Carbon Emission Prediction Method for the Steel Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the increasing global attention to environmental issues, carbon reduction has become a crucial task across industries. The steel industry, as one of the significant sources of carbon emissions, plays a vital role in achieving dual carbon goals. In this research, a data-driven ensemble learning model for the steel industry is proposed, aimed at predicting carbon emissions from steel enterprises. The model serves as a basis for formulating emission reduction policies and driving technological innovation within the industry. Firstly, the data undergoes preprocessing, and input feature variables are determined through the Pearson correlation coefficient. Secondly, the data is input into the enhanced Stacking ensemble learning model. The final output error metrics are used as the objective function, and the Bayesian optimization algorithm is employed to adjust the hyperparameters of the Stacking model's dual-layer learners. Finally, the prediction results are further optimized through an error compensation model. The proposed method was validated through practical examples, demonstrating its ability to further enhance the accuracy and robustness of predictions.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Adaptive Control Strategy for Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control strategy simulates the operating characteristics of conventional generators and brings stability to renewable energy power system. However, the difficulties in parameters tuning for a VSG hinder the further practical application in power systems. Besides, a VSG with fixed parameters might have a bad performance if the working condition changes. The rapid development of Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods bring solutions to this issue. In this paper, deep deterministic gradient policy (DDPG) method is applied to adjust the virtual moment of inertia and virtual damping factor in real time. The performance of the VSG is improved with the RL method and the validity of the algorithm is confirmed compared with other methods in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A Temperature Detection Method for Electrical Equipment Based on Infrared Thermal Image
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: During the operation of electrical equipment, if there are abnormal situations that cause overheating, it can lead to equipment damage and even serious consequences such as fire. To improve the reliability of electrical equipment design and avoid thermal faults, it is necessary to monitor the temperature of the equipment. The infrared thermal image temperature measurement method has the advantages of rich temperature information, wide detection range, and no equipment contact. The traditional thermal image detection method requires manual designation of the detection area. When the position of the object to be detected changes, the detection area needs to be reassigned. In order to effectively monitor the running state of the equipment, this paper proposes a method for detecting thermal faults in electrical equipment thermal images. This method is based on the improved YOLOv8 algorithm, incorporating Coordinate Attention (CA) into the backbone to enhance the model's learning ability of location information. The Local Intensities Operation (LIO) is used to separate the equipment from the background, and finally, the temperature of the equipment is counted and whether a thermal fault has occurred is calculated.

articleTitle: A Study on the Carbon Emission Prediction Method in the Ceramic Industry using Stacking Ensemble Learning based on Bayesian Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the increasing severity of global environmental issues, reducing carbon emissions has become an urgent problem to be solved in various fields. As a typical representative of high energy consumption and high carbon emissions, the accurate prediction of carbon emissions in the ceramic industry is of great value. This study proposes a Stacking ensemble learning model based on Bayesian optimization to predict the carbon emissions of ceramic enterprises, providing a reference for the implementation of emission reduction measures and promoting technological innovation. First, the raw data is preprocessed, and input feature variables are selected using the Pearson correlation coefficient. Then, these features are input into the proposed improved Stacking ensemble learning model, using the output error index as the optimization target. Bayesian optimization is subsequently employed to adjust the hyperparameters of the two-layer learners in the Stacking ensemble learning, while the error compensation model is used to further optimize the prediction results. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through a practical case analysis. The experimental results show that compared with the original Stacking model, the improved Stacking model can produce more accurate prediction results.

articleTitle: Scalable Fault- Tolerant Voltage Control of AC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel fault-tolerant control strategy for voltage restoration in microgrids, taking into account partial actuator effectiveness loss faults. Instead of using centralized communication networks and predefined fault boundaries, this strategy operates in a decentralized manner. Each generator in the system only needs to know information about its neighboring generators, rather than the entire network. This approach can be applied not only to restoring voltage in power grids but also to other systems involving multiple agents with linear interactions. Simulation results confirm that the algorithm is effective in practice. This technological innovation holds promise for providing more reliable and robust solutions for future energy systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Visibility: A Study on Transmission Line Image Mist Removal Techniques Based on Allen-Cahn Diffusion Equation*
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper evaluates an image dehazing algorithm applying Allen-Cahn diffusion equation (AC). The algorithm is tested on grayscale images of transmission lines captured on foggy days, processed at a resolution of 512 × 512 pixels. We focus on three specific images to assess the effectiveness of the dehazing process. The algorithm iterates 241 times with a dehazing coefficient of λ set to 100, aimed at optimizing visibility. Results are documented through sequential figures that demonstrate the progressive clarity achieved, underscoring the algorithm's capability to efficiently remove fog from images.

articleTitle: A Novel Interleaved LLC Resonant Converter with Multiple Outputs
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To meet the requirements of high power-density, high efficiency and multiple outputs, a parallel LLC converter with multi-load is proposed. Compared with the conventional dual LLC converter, it successfully improves the step-down conversion ratio and reduces the number of power components. The primary active switches are turned on at ZVS and secondary rectifier diodes are turned off at ZCS. Meanwhile, multiple outputs are realized. Finally, a 400W laboratory prototype interleaved LLC resonant converter is developed, with input voltage of 200V and output voltage of 48V and 36V. The experimental result verifies the feasibility of the design, and the simple circuit topology can meet the design requirements well.

articleTitle: Analysis for Working Characteristics of Three Level Push-Pull Bidirectional DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper studies a three-level push-pull bidirectional DC/DC converter which can be used in the energy storage link of power router. It have characteristics of high gain, small current ripple and wide input voltage range. In this paper, firstly, the working mechanism of the converter is studied based on the principle of voltage matching at both ends of the transmission inductor, and the forward and reverse working modes of the converter are deeply analyzed. Taking one working mode as an example, eight working stages under this mode are analyzed in detail. Secondly, the effects of duty cycle, inter-bridge shift ratio and intra-bridge shift ratio on power transfer and the system performance in different modes are investigated to achieve high efficiency power transfer of the converter. Finally, the experimental research is carried out on a 3 kW experimental platform, and the experimental results verify the correctness of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Optimization Scheme of Steady-State and Dynamic Performance for Dual Active Bridge Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To comprehensively enhance the performance of the dual active bridge (DAB) converter, a comprehensive optimization scheme of steady-state and dynamic performance is proposed. First, an asymmetric extended phase shift (AEPS) modulation scheme is introduced, aimed at reducing the peak-to-peak inductor current, thereby improving the steady-state performance of the DAB converter under a wide voltage gain range. Subsequently, a load current direct control (LCDC) scheme is proposed, integrating the load current into the control loop to rapidly change the phase shift ratio of AEPS within a switching period when the load resistance changes, thus maintaining the output voltage essentially stable. This culminates in the comprehensive optimization scheme. Finally, the simulation results from MATLAB/Simulink confirm the proposed comprehensive optimization scheme, demonstrating that it not only enhances the steady-state performance under a wide voltage gain, especially under light load conditions, but also possesses excellent dynamic response characteristics.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Anti-Static Induction Device for 220kV Outdoor Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Most 220kV outdoor current transformers in substations are oil-filled current transformers. Sampling and testing of the insulating oil play an important role in early detection of potential faults within the current transformer and timely warning of abnormal conditions. When the current transformer is powered to take oil samples, it is often affected by inductive electricity. In severe cases, the operator may fall from a high place. However, the personal security line is suitable for the connection between the power-off line or the power-off equipment and the earth. This paper discusses that the personal security line is not suitable for live working, and there are some hidden dangers. Therefore, this article designed a set of 220kV outdoor current transformer anti-induction electricity device, which can effectively solve the above problems.

articleTitle: Stochastic Optimization a New Method Based on for Solving Dynamic Reactive Power Optimization Problems Involving Renewable Energy and Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The use of renewable energy for power generation is receiving increasing attention. However, the high uncertainty of renewable energy increases the difficulty of maintaining stable operation of the power system; On the contrary, some constraints of the power system can only be satisfied in high probability situations. In this paper, a dynamic reactive power optimization model with chance constraints is proposed, which effectively integrates energy storage and renewable energy to meet the requirements of renewable energy integration. Specifically, this paper requires that wind energy account for at least a predetermined proportion of total demand, and assumes that wind energy can complete this power generation plan. We propose a new sampling method based on the partial sample average approximate (PSAA) framework to effectively solve large-scale chance constrained dynamic reactive power optimization problems. The computational experiments on the modified IEEE-14 bus system show that the proposed method is more accurate and the computational time cost is less than the average approximate value of the standard sample.

articleTitle: SOC Balance of Islanded DC Microgrid Based on Consensus Algorithm and Adaptive Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Distributed energy storage units are often used in isolated DC microgrid. To prevent overcharge and discharge of energy storage units, it is necessary to balance the SOC of each energy storage unit to facilitate the monitoring of SOC of energy storage units. Therefore, the consensus algorithm is used to balance the real-time SOC of each energy storage unit. Combined with adaptive droop control, the output current of each energy storage unit is controlled, and the current proportion coefficient is defined. At the same time, the control strategy considers the difference of line impedance of each energy storage unit and can ensure the stability of bus voltage of islanded DC microgrid when the system operation reaches steady state. The influence of DC load change on SOC balance of each energy storage unit in islanded DC microgrid is also considered. Finally, the control strategy is simulated and verified in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Short-Term Prediction of Multi-Load in Integrated Energy Systems Based on Coupling Characteristic Analysis and Multi-Task Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the continuous development of integrated energy technology and the diversification of users' energy demand, the current single load forecasting method is no longer satisfied with the requirements of multivariate load forecasting. The accurate prediction of multivariate load is related to the rationality of integrated energy systems operation scheduling. Therefore, this paper proposes a multitask learning model prediction method based on CNN-BiLSTM. First, the coupling characteristics between multivariate loads in the integrated energy system are analyzed, and the coupling features between loads are constructed; then, the correlation degree between meteorological factors and multivariate loads is analyzed according to the Pearson correlation coefficient method to determine the input features of the model; finally, CNN-BiLSTM is used as the shared learning layer of multi-task learning to deeply explore the coupling relationship between loads. Meanwhile, the output layer of each subtask is constructed, and the weights of each task are dynamically adjusted with the GradNorm algorithm to optimize the model. The data set of Tempe Campus of Arizona State University is used as an example for validation, and the proposed method is proved to have better application in prediction accuracy by comparing with various prediction models.

articleTitle: Sensor Alignment for Ballistic Target Tracking Based on Sparse Representation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Sensor alignment for tracking of ballistic target is an important research topic in the field of aerospace. A particle filter based on sparse representation is proposed to achieve sensor alignment in this paper. The system state is established by combining the trajectory of ballistic target and the systematic errors of measurements. The sparse representation model of the system state is constructed by using the sparse characteristic of systematic errors. The posterior distribution of the system state is recursively calculated by using particle filter. Then, the trajectory and systematic errors are estimated simultaneously. To improve the filtering performance, a constrained optimization model is constructed and solved to estimate the support set of the system state. Then, the support set is tuned to be adapted for the existence of systematic errors. Simulation results show that the proposed filter can improve the estimation accuracy of trajectory over the existing filters. The estimates of systematic errors are close to the true values, indicating that the on-line sensor alignment is achieved successfully.

articleTitle: A Fully Distributed Resilient Control Strategy Based on Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In real-world scenarios, communication anomalies among multiple agents are inevitable. To address this issue, especially in situations where full-state measurements are unavailable, this paper introduces the concept of an elastic observer. Furthermore, considering a directed communication network, the paper achieves decoupling of asymmetric Laplacian matrices and adaptive dynamics. The designed control strategy aims to avoid reliance on global information from the directed communication network and abnormal boundaries in instances of communication link disruptions.

articleTitle: Anomalous Access Behavior Detection Method Based on Multi-Source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The stable operation of the power grid is crucial, the promotion and application of various types of information technology in the power grid, all kinds of state perception information can be uploaded to the power grid control center in a timely manner. By analyzing the information of multi-source data fusion, abnormal access behavior is detected, which provides a rich source of information for grid security analysis and decision-making and intelligent diagnosis of faults. Therefore, this paper introduces a framework and method for abnormal access behavior detection based on multi-source data fusion. In order to provide a certain reference for the efficient implementation of abnormal access detection of power grid data.

articleTitle: Aplication of Gaussian Filtering Technique in Surface Roughness Extraction Based on Qt
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the upper computer of surface roughness instrument lacks real-time analysis of the raw surface roughness data, and overly relies on the data uploaded by the surface roughness instrument after Gaussian filtering by the instrument itself, thus leading to the lack of precision. In this paper, a method based on Qt implementation of Gaussian filtering technique is proposed to extract the information of roughness from the raw data of surface roughness to improve the measurement accuracy. This technology combines the advantages of the Qt graphical user interface, through the Gaussian filtering technology to complete the extraction of surface roughness information of objects. First, the raw data of surface roughness of the object is acquired by the sensor. Second, the Gaussian filtering algorithm is used to process and analyze the collected raw data to extract the effective information in the surface roughness. Finally, the obtained roughness information is analyzed and compared with the data extracted by the wavelet filtering technique and the measured values of the surface roughness meter. The experimental results show that this method can effectively extract surface roughness information, improve the measurement accuracy, and provide a reliable technical means for real-time analysis of surface roughness data in the upper computer of the surface roughness instrument.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Operation of an Integrated Energy System Containing Carbon Capture System and Hydrogen Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: So as to upgrade the low-carbon economy and promote multi-energy complementarity of the integrated energy system, a low-carbon economic operation and scheduling model of the integrated energy system, containing hydrogen energy, power to gas, combined heat and power system and carbon capture system, is proposed. Firstly, the operation architecture of the integrated energy system is proposed, and the internal equipment is finely modeled, and the energy coupling relationship between each equipment is analyzed. Secondly, the optimal scheduling model of the integrated energy system was constructed, the operation mechanism and energy direction of each equipment were systematically analyzed, the objective function, containing the minimum aggregate operating cost of the integrated energy system, and the lowest carbon emissions, was established. Finally, the optimized output of each equipment is solved by MATLAB, in which the wind energy consumption and the light energy consumption are increased by 11.7% and 26.72%, respectively, and the overall system cost is reduced by 850081.6 yuan, which tremendously demonstrates the advantages of the optimal scheduling model.

articleTitle: Aggregation Method for Electric Vehicles with Multi-Source Information Fusion Including Social Attributes
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: As the concept of sustainable development becomes increasingly prevalent, the number of new energy vehicles is also on the rise. New energy vehicles, as flexible and controllable resources on the distribution network side, are a double-edged sword for the safe and stable operation of the distribution network. On the one hand, the large-scale and unorganized charging of new energy vehicles poses a significant challenge to the stable operation of the distribution network. On the other hand, with the continuous increase in the penetration rate of distributed renewable energy sources in the new power system, reasonable control of the charging and discharging behavior of electric vehicles can reduce the impact of renewable energy output uncertainty on the fluctuation of the distribution network. Therefore, this paper proposes an aggregation method for electric vehicles with multi-source information fusion considering social attributes. Firstly, a classification analysis of multi-source attributes affecting the charging and discharging behavior of electric vehicles is conducted. Secondly, the Pearson correlation coefficient is used to quantitatively analyze the correlation between multiple attributes and electric vehicle behavior. NetLogo software is used to simulate the charging and discharging behavior of electric vehicle groups, demonstrating the effectiveness and scientific nature of the proposed aggregation method for electric vehicles with multi-source information fusion considering social attributes.

articleTitle: Study on Electricity Retail Packages for Multi-Market Synergy Development
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the construction of new power systems and the deepening of power market reform, retail packages have become the core content in the construction of the power retail market, and the demand for retail packages has become increasingly diversified under this environment. This paper focuses on the study of power retail packages for the synergistic development of multiple markets, firstly, market analysis and demand research on the power market should be carried out, and then the design principles of power retail packages should be clarified, and the optimisation strategy of power retail packages based on demand response should be proposed, and the scope of its use should be given.

articleTitle: New Approach Sliding Mode Control of PMSM Based on Perturbation Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Aiming at the disturbances and uncertainties faced by permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs) in conventional PI control methods, this paper proposes a novel sliding mode control (SMC) strategy that employs an adaptive reaching law and a disturbance observer (DOB). The new control strategy not only attenuates the vibration of the control signal and shortens the time for the system trajectory to reach the sliding mode surface, but also improves the robustness of the speed regulation system by estimating the unknown disturbances through the disturbance observer and providing feedforward compensation. In addition, a nonlinear active disturbance suppression current controller is designed in this paper to improve the anti-interference performance of the current loop. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy and observer and their stability are verified through comprehensive simulations and experiments, which are demonstrated using the Liapunov stability theory.

articleTitle: Dynamic Event-Triggered Neural Network-Based Approach for Solving the Decentralized Guaranteed Cost Control Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: For the interconnected large-scale systems, a dynamic event-triggered neural network-based approach is designed to solve the guaranteed cost control (GCC) problem in this paper. First, the decentralized GCC policies are obtained via solving a modified Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. To alleviate the waste of communication and computing resources, the dynamic event-triggered mode is involved in the ADP-based GCC strategy of interconnection systems. The triggering instants can be dynamically adjusted by introducing dynamic parameters related to the system dynamics into the triggering conditions. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed approach is presented by a digital simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Scale Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering Electric-Thermal Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the development of economic society, multiple types of consumer loads, primarily electrical and thermal, are accessed in the integrated energy system, posing challenges for system dispatch. In this paper, a multi-time scale optimization strategy for integrated energy systems considering electric-thermal demand response is proposed in an effort to further exploit adjustable load resources on the user side and enhance the economic operation efficiency of the system. In view of the differences in the response of demand-side resources at different time scales, in the day-ahead stage, electric loads are analyzed on the basis of price-based demand responses, while thermal loads are divided into residential heating loads and industrial loads, with demand response modeling tailored to each type of characteristic. In the intra-day stage, both electric and thermal loads consider incentive-based demand response strategies, and the type of load participating in the response is reducible. The impact of integrated demand response on system operation costs is discussed, and the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by means of multi-scenario example simulations.
