Additionally, the multi-time scale optimization dispatch strategy can effectively mitigate the impact of source load forecasting errors on the system.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Digital Supply Chain Finance Platform in Oil and Gas Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The oil and gas industry is an important part of the economy and energy strategy of countries, with the characteristics of large economic aggregate, long industrial chain, strong technical expertise and high complexity. Supply chain finance is an important tool to improve supply chain resilience, ease corporate financing constraints, and reduce financial transaction risks. In the context of the digital transformation of the industrial chain, in order to break the development problems such as closure and centralization under the traditional supply chain finance model, the digital supply chain finance platform has been created by using block chain, big data and Internet of things. The platform relies on the reconstruction of the bank's core business system to build a foundation for digital transformation, integrates the business flow, logistics, capital and information flow of the industrial chain at the base and application layer, and improves the supply chain financial product system based on the oil and gas industry, embedding bank financial services into all aspects of the oil and gas industry production and sales. This paper introduces the construction of digital supply chain finance platform. The application for the oil and gas industry shows that under the condition of data sharing and mutual trust, taking the digital supply chain financial service platform as the starting point can improve financing efficiency, reduce financing costs and risks, expand financing capacity, enhance supply chain value and competitiveness, and help the high-quality development of the oil and gas industry

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Considering Economic and Environmental Indexes of CCHP System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In contemporary research on combined cooling, heating, and power (CCHP) systems, prevalent models predominantly emphasize either the cost of components or their environmental ramifications, thereby neglecting comprehensive optimization of operational performance. This study proposes a dual-focused optimization model that concurrently addresses economic efficiency and environmental sustainability within such systems. The model integrates key components including gas turbines, gas boilers, and electric refrigerators, delineating pertinent operational constraints. To refine the objectives encompassing multiple constraints, an enhanced particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is introduced. This algorithm advances the accuracy, velocity, and stability of the convergence process. An empirical case study is employed to validate the model, demonstrating that the improved PSO algorithm adeptly harmonizes the economic and environmental objectives, thereby optimizing system operations and laying a robust groundwork for the strategic planning of future energy supply systems.

Author Keywords: improved particle swarm multi-objective optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Decoding Circuit of Linear Differential Variable Voltage Sensor for an Actuator Drive Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: As an indispensable part of high-precision LVDT, the performance of LVDT signal demodulation circuit directly determines the accuracy of its output signal. According to the performance requirements of manned airship, the LVDT demodulation circuit supporting the tail aircraft drive controller is designed, the experimental verification and theoretical analysis are carried out for the output stroke out of tolerance of the tail steering gear. According to the power supply requirements of AD698AP demodulation chip in the circuit, the specific measures to optimize the temperature drift problem of LVDT demodulation circuit are put forward, so as to maximize the range of DSP, improve the precision of the product and meet the application requirements of the product.

articleTitle: Distributed Voltage Regulation of Distribution Network Based on Partition Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: As China's social economy progresses, the amount of equipment in distribution networks continues to grow, leading to increasingly complex system operations. In this environment, traditional centralized control methods consume excessive computing resources and fail to achieve the processing speeds required by modern intelligent distribution networks. To address these challenges, this article introduces the concept of electrical distance to segment the distribution network and proposes voltage regulation algorithms based on the alternating direction multiplier method and dual ascent method for efficient distributed voltage regulation.

Author Keywords: Alternating direction multiplier method for regulation

articleTitle: Adaptive Denoising Study Based on Improved Variable Step Size LMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To overcome the signal noise problem in small-current grounding systems, an improved LMS adaptive filter algorithm using a symmetric nonlinear function to adjust the step size is proposed in this paper. This algorithm makes innovative improvements to the Sigmoid function by using the absolute value and the nonlinear stretch to construct a new symmetric nonlinear function, which realizes the nonlinear mapping between the step size factor and the steady state error. The method not only solves the problem of noise accumulation and amplification through the normalized variable step factor, but also significantly improves the filtering effect and accelerates the convergence process of the algorithm. In addition, the particle swarm optimization method is combined to finely adjust the step size factor to the optimal one to further improve the denoising performance. After rigorous theoretical analysis and simulation experiments under various conditions, the results demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed algorithm in suppressing noise, accelerating convergence, and improving the output signal-to-noise ratio, especially in the low signal-to-noise ratio environment and dynamic change conditions, which show remarkable stability and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Resilient Control Strategies for Multi-Area Interconnected Power Systems: Combating External FDI Attacks with UIO and Adaptive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This work proposes a robust control technique to mitigate false data injection (FDI) attacks on multi-region interconnected power systems. The strategy is based on unknown input observer (UIO) and adaptive control. In order to preserve system performance and stability, adaptive control technology dynamically modifies controller parameters based on estimates from UIO. The efficacy and resilience of the suggested approach are confirmed by numerical simulation and real-world examples, which provide crucial technical support for the power system stability and safety.

articleTitle: Fully Distributed Resilient Secondary Control of Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: We propose a resilient voltage regulation strategy for microgrids based on a directed communication network. Initially, we employ feedback linearization techniques to address the inherent nonlinear complexity in distributed generation (DG) dynamics. Additionally, we design a resilient secondary voltage controller that may be susceptible to false data injection (FDI) attacks. This control strategy reduces reliance on global information and boundaries of attack signals within the communication network, thereby enhancing system resilience and efficiency. Finally, through comprehensive simulation experiments, we evaluate the effectiveness and performance of the proposed strategy. Simulation results validate the success of the method in voltage regulation and fault management. These findings are of significant importance for the development of voltage regulation strategies in distributed generation systems.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Fault Ranging Method Based on ICEEMDAN-HFWEO
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In the traveling wave fault localization method, the fault traveling wave head extraction accuracy determines the fault localization accuracy, this paper proposes a transmission line fault ranging method based on ICEEMDAN-HFWEO as a way to improve the extraction accuracy of traveling wave head. Firstly, for the defect that the single line mode component of the traditional phase mode transform matrix cannot characterize all types of faults, the Clark phase mode transform matrix is improved so that the single line mode component can characterize all types of faults; on this basis, ICEEMDAN (Improved Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Based on this, ICEEMDAN (Improved Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise) and HFWEO (Higher-order Frequency Weighted Energy Operator) are proposed as a combination of travelling waveform header extraction methods, which improves the extraction accuracy of the faulty travelling waveheads and realizes the accurate fault localization. Simulation experiments have proved that the proposed method can realize accurate fault localization of transmission lines under different transition resistances, different fault types and different fault distances, and the localization errors are less than 150m.

articleTitle: An Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based Intelligent Operator for Power Transmission Lines Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Nowadays, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has been increasingly employed in power transmission lines inspection and maintenance to alleviate the conventional manual effort. Nevertheless, UAV based intelligent operator is often difficult to be used under long distance and nighttime operation. Hence, this paper designs a new intelligent operator, which can stably and flexibly work beyond line of sight by improving the control system, support comprehensive perspective coverage with the optimization of real-time image monitoring system, and provide ample illumination for various nighttime operations through adopting a comprehensive spotlight combination scheme. The design is effectively validated through experimental results, which is expected to be attractive in UAV assisted power transmission lines maintenance.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Probability Forecasting Based on Fuzzy Clustering and Quantile Regression with Minimum Gate Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Load forecasting is an important basis for power system planning and design, facing the energy demand of users in different time periods. There is an issue of data imbalance in training load historical curve data. In this context, this paper proposes a short-term load forecasting method based on fuzzy clustering and minimum gate unit quantile regression. Firstly, the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is used for data cluster analysis, and a fully connected neural network is employed to aggregate the long-term trend features and short-term trend features of the load. Next, a convolutional neural network is utilized for feature extraction and obtaining a cluster membership matrix. Subsequently, the cluster membership matrix is used for sample weighting in training. Different load categories are used to train the minimum gate unit quantile regression model for interval prediction. Then, the membership degree is used to weight the minimum gate units for ensemble integration. Finally, the proposed method is validated on a 2016-2018 load dataset in a certain region of Quanzhou, showing improved accuracy compared to traditional time series forecasting models.

articleTitle: Combined Three-Phase PFC Converter and Control Based on Two-Switch Three-Level
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Three-phase power factor correction (PFC) is a necessity unit in high power electric vehicle charging station converters to obtain a high power factor on the AC side and especially to reduce the harmonic pollution of the grid. This paper proposed combined three-phase power factor correction (PFC) converter comprises of three single-phase two-switch three-level Boost converters. The converter offers a simple structure, high circuit reliability, and redundancy, etc. This paper describes in detail the working principle of the main circuit of PFC and establishes its mathematical model. It studies the double closed-loop control for realizing the unit power factor, in which the current loop adopts a single-zero bipolar compensation network to enhance its open-loop gain in the low-frequency band, compared to the traditional PI regulator. This network also suppresses high-frequency interference and oscillations of the input current. Additionally, a digital average current PFC control is implemented using DSP. Theoretical analysis is confirmed by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Multi-Agent Cooperative Control Based on Fuzzy Logic System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper presents a solution for controlling a type of multi-agent system (MAS) where communication goes both ways, and the weights associated with each agent may not be equal, while their behaviors can be nonlinear. The proposed approach, called distributed leader-following consensus control, relies on agents exchanging information locally with their neighbors and each agent having its own control mechanism. By carefully selecting Lyapunov functions, the paper proves that the system achieves stable and asymptotically convergent leader- following consensus in a multi-agent scenario.

articleTitle: Fault- Tolerant Multi-Agent Control Based on Asymmetric Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: A new control strategy is proposed for managing multiple agents in a network where communication flows in both directions but may not be symmetrical. These agents might encounter problems where their actuators lose some effectiveness or suffer from bias faults. These faults can vary over time and may differ between agents. The strategy incorporates adaptive methods to handle information related to these faults effectively. Furthermore, it uses a technique called boundary layer construction to design controllers that operate smoothly, avoiding the jittery behavior that can occur with less refined control methods.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage and Frequency Secondary Control Strategy of Grid-Forming Converters with Distributed Consensus Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In practical operating conditions, the disparate equivalent output impedances of the system's multiple converters connected in parallel result in an uneven distribution of reactive power (assuming the converters' equivalent output impedances are inductive), consequently engendering circulating currents amongst them. A virtual impedance control technique is put forth in this paper to address these problems. It can lower the circulating current between converters and accomplish precise reactive power distribution. The frequency and voltage will fluctuate when using droop control because they don't receive consistent support from the main grid. Meanwhile, voltage drops brought on by the addition of virtual impedance control will affect the system's ability to operate steadily. This paper addresses these issues by using a multi-agent distributed consensus control technique based on information transmission via sparse communication networks, enabling secondary frequency and voltage modification. Ultimately, the suggested control technique is verified through single-bus and mesh topologies. The case study results demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of this control strategy for secondary control in microgrids.

articleTitle: Distributed Voltage Control of DC Microgrid via a Constructed PD Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the distributed voltage control problem of DC micro grid consisting of some different type of DC distributed generation (DG) units powered by wind and solar energies. A new distributed voltage controller is proposed for this DC micro grid to make all DG's voltages synchronize. Meanwhile, the controller is designed by using a distributed PD idea, and based on multi-agent system (MAS) with external disturbances which is obtained by transforming the original microgrid model. Finally, the simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Intelligent Tracking Control of Nonlinear Systems with Pure-Feedback Structure Using Optimized Backstepping
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This article studies the problem of adaptive optimized finite-time tracking control for a class of nonlinear single-input single-output systems in the form of pure-feedback. In order to realizing the finite optimal control, the adaptive optimized control technology is used. Based on the low-pass filter, an adaptive finite-time optimized scheme is presented, which can address the problem of algebraic loop. It can be demonstrated that based on the proposed adaptive optimized controller, both the optimized tracking and finite-time control are guaranteed. A simulation of the actual nonlinear system proves the validity of the presented method.

articleTitle: Soft-Sensing System Design Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Expounding the implementation process of an online estimation system for glutamic acid bacterial concentration designed using LabVIEW with graphical programming language and BP neural network soft-sensing. By selecting parameters such as ventilation, sugar supplementation, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{pH}$</tex>, and temperature during the glutamic acid fermentation process as auxiliary variables for soft sensor modeling, the important biological parameter affecting the fermentation process and product quality, bacterial concentration, is determined as the target variable for softsensing modeling. The BP neural network in the machine learning toolkit provided by LabVIEW is called, and it is modeled by the BP neural network is trained and tested using sample data. Through simulation results analysis, it has been proven that soft-sensing system of LabVIEW can achieve online estimation of bacterial concentration in the glutamic acid fermentation process.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Model Parameters on the Output Characteristics of Photovoltaic Arrays in Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Studying the output characteristics of photovoltaic cells forms the foundation for the design of photovoltaic power systems and the tracking of maximum power points. The output characteristics of the cell model are determined by changes in its parameters. The impact of series resistance, environmental illumination, and temperature variations on the output of photovoltaic cells within the framework of a five-parameter cell model are analyzed. Modeling and simulation are conducted using MATLAB software. The effects of series resistance and parallel resistance on the output characteristics of photovoltaic cells in a static environment are concluded. Additionally, the impact of different illuminations and temperatures on the output characteristics of both series and parallel photovoltaic arrays in dynamic environments are also concluded. Theoretical analysis has been conducted, and the findings provide references for the design and maximum power point tracking of photovoltaic arrays in dynamic environments.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Topology High Efficiency LLC Applied to Wide Gain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The LLC resonant converter is commonly used in isolated DC-DC converters due to its excellent characteristics, including low EMI, high frequency, high power density, and high efficiency. Currently, the wide-gain LLC resonant converter is a popular area of research. This paper proposes an improved gain model for the traditional LLC resonant converter and applies it to the full/half-bridge topology dynamically switched LLC resonant converter. Additionally, a design methodology and topology dynamic switching control strategy are presented for an efficient wide-gain LLC resonant converter based on the improved gain model and dynamic topology switching. The proposed methodology and control strategy improve the dynamic effect during the topology switching process. The design methodology and control strategy are validated through experiments.

articleTitle: Rotor Position Estimation Method of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Loss Function Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness and stability of permanent magnet synchronous motor rotor position estimation, a rotor position estimation method based on loss function optimization is proposed. Firstly, the adaptive observer of permanent magnet synchronous motor is designed to realize the real-time observation and estimation of the motor speed and position Angle. Then, the error between the velocity estimate and the reference value is evaluated by the loss function to determine the accuracy of the observer model. Finally, an optimization function is designed using the error value to compensate the observed PMSM speed estimate, so as to improve the robustness and stability of the control system. Simulink comparison shows that the position Angle value estimated by the rotor position estimation method based on loss function optimization can track the actual position Angle well. The estimated rotor angular velocity value not only overcomes the problem of mutation and greatly improves the disturbance resistance of the system, but also improves the angular velocity fluctuation of the motor rotor in steady state. The stability of the system is improved.

articleTitle: The Sharing Transaction Mechanism of Multi Energy Virtual Power Plant with Flexible Combined Heat and Power Units
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the development of distributed energy and the progress of information and communication technology, virtual power plants has gradually developed from the aggregation of a single energy source to the aggregation and management of multiple energy sources. As an important multi-energy coupling equipment, the CHP(Combined Heat and Power) plays an important role in multi-energy VPP (Virtual Power Plant). However, the traditional CHP has the disadvantage of a fixed electrothermal ratio and can not simulate the real scene. Therefore, this paper proposes a flexible CHP. At the same time, considering the scheduling deviation and energy supply stability caused by the diversity of user behavior and the difference of resource scale, this paper puts forward a sharing transaction mechanism of multi-energy virtual power plants based on asymmetric Nash bargaining, which realizes the power complementarity between regions of multi-energy virtual power plants through the interaction of electrothermal energy between regions. This mechanism not only improves the energy efficiency and overall income of multi-energy virtual power plant alliance, but also reduces the operating cost of each virtual power plant. The effectiveness of the proposed mechanism is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Management Strategy for Integrated Energy System Towards Lower Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To decrease the degree of dependence on fuel-based resources, it is necessary to reform the energy system. Integrated energy system (IES) combined heating and power networks, realizes the cooperation of heterogeneous energies. To improve the efficiency of energy utilization, an energy management problem is investigated in this paper. Firstly, an energy management model of IES is constructed with the considerations of economy benefits and carbon emissions. Moreover, the carbon capture device and carbon storage device are installed in IES as well, which introduces a tax trading mechanism. Then, based on the method of alternating multipliers, a fully distributed energy management algorithm is designed to acquire the optimal solutions. Finally, simulation results prove the effectiveness of the constructed model and the distributed algorithm,

articleTitle: Open Circuit Fault Diagnosis Method for DC Microgrids Based on Improved Pearson Correlation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: A fault diagnosis method based on improved Pearson correlation algorithm and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed to address the issue of high diagnostic speed and high proportion of semiconductor power transistor faults in DC-DC converters in DC microgrids. This method uses the triangular wave algorithm to convert the PWM fault signal output by the power electronic controller into a triangular wave signal, and performs a rolling window correlation operation with the DC bus voltage ripple characteristic signal. Subsequently, the calculated correlation coefficients are combined with convolutional neural networks (CNN) to achieve fast and accurate diagnosis of open circuit faults in semiconductor power transistors. The simulation test results based on MATLAB/Simulink show that the proposed fault diagnosis method can quickly and accurately identify the open circuit fault of semiconductor power transistors in DC microgrids.

Author Keywords: Pearson related algorithm fault diagnosis CNN open circuit fault

articleTitle: Cooperative Power Grid Inspection for Swarm of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Guided by Virtual Sphere
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: A cooperative power grid inspection scenario as-sisted by a swarm of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV s) is investigated in this paper, where leader UAV s form a virtual sphere formation and guide the follower UAV s in tracking the given power grid inspection trajectory. It is required that follower UAV s achieve the containment control, with the positions of each follower converging into the virtual sphere viewed as the convex hull. The power grid inspection trajectory is generated by a parametric equation through tuning the radius, polar angle, and azimuth angle. The containment control protocol is devised and the stability of follower UAV systems can be guaranteed based on Lyapunov theory. A numerical simulation and a power grid inspection scenario are presented finally to validate the proposed containment control scheme.

articleTitle: A Self-Adaptive Harris Corner Detection Algorithm Based on Image contrast Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Largely for this reason that the threshold value of Harris algorithms can only be set by experience, corner is difficult to be contrasted in areas of image contrast. A new adaptive algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, image pixels are selected by Sudoku method. Secondly, image contrast can be confirmed in area of above-mentioned pixels by calculating local mean square error. Finally, the best matching pixels according to image contrast are received by using self-adaption threshold, and experimental results can demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed adaptive Harris corner detection Algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of LSTM Model Based on Sparrow Search Algorithm for Carbon Emission Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In the context of realizing the goal of “double carbon”, it is of great guiding significance to forecast the carbon emissions of key energy-using industries. In this paper, an optimized LSTM model based on sparrow search algorithm is proposed to predict the carbon emission of ceramic industry and provide guidance for relevant enterprises to formulate emission reduction policies. In this paper, the carbon emission data of ceramic industry is preprocessed first, and the processed data is normalized. On this basis, the sparrow search algorithm is used for hyperparameter optimization, and then the carbon emission is predicted by LSTM. In order to further improve the optimization effect of the model, the Attention mechanism is introduced to optimize the model. By comparing the prediction effect of LSTM, LSTM-attention, SSA-LSTM and SSA-LSTM-attention models with error function, it is concluded that the prediction accuracy of the SSA-LSTM-attention model used in this paper is the best. The precision of carbon emission prediction in ceramic industry is further improved.

articleTitle: The Energy Storage Configuration Strategy of Biomass Thermal Power Plant with Multi-Market Cooperative Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Under the double background of the rapid expansion of the proportion of new energy and the marketization of electricity, fully tapping the ability of biomass thermal power plants to participate in the electricity energy market and ancillary service market can not only maximize the income of biomass thermal power plants, but also provide effective support for the safe operation of the power system. Aiming at the capacity limitation of electric and thermal energy storage and the feasibility and compatibility of multi-market operation, this paper proposes an energy storage configuration strategy of biomass thermal power plant considering multimarket cooperative operation. Firstly, the operation state of energy storage participating in the electric energy market and the configuration of heat storage devices under the condition of optimal output of each power generation unit are studied. Then, the profit conditions of energy storage participating in peaking ancillary service and backup ancillary service are considered, and the constraints of energy storage devices participating in multi-market operation are improved to obtain the electric energy storage capacity configuration. The feasibility of this strategy is verified by the example simulation, which can effectively improve the willingness of biomass power plants to participate in ancillary services and improve the economy of power plant operation

articleTitle: Robust Distributed Fixed-Time Economic Dispatch Method for Ship Power System with Bounded Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: To improve energy efficiency and ensure safe navigation for sailing ships, this paper proposes a robust distributed fixed-time economic dispatch method, which can solve the economic dispatch problem (EDP) for the ship power system. Firstly, the economic dispatch model for ship power system is constructed, aimed at minimizing power generation costs under the constraints of the supply-demand balance and the output power. Then, considering the actual operating environment of the ship power system, the robust distributed fixed-time economic dispatch method is proposed to suppress the bounded disturbance. Moreover, based on first-order sliding mode control and fixed time control, the optimal economic dispatch decisions can be obtained within a fixed settling time, in order to ensure the high-efficiency operation of the ship power system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulations.

articleTitle: Ground Fault Detection in Substation DC System Based on Improved Unbalanced Bridge Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: DC system is an important part in substation system, DC system can lead to accidents such as protection error or refusal to operate, relay burnout and equipment fault tripping, which endanger the safe operation of power grid. This paper proposes a ground fault detection method for DC system of substation based on improved unbalanced bridge. Firstly, the equivalent model of normal and fault operation of substation DC system is established, and a method combining the improved unbalanced bridge method and leakage current sensor method is proposed to detect DC system grounding faults, which solves the complex problem of calculating the DC system grounding equivalent resistance of the traditional unbalanced bridge. Then the calculation principles of the grounding resistance parallel value measurement method, the DC branch to ground resistance measurement method and the busbar to ground resistance measurement method are analysed respectively on the basis of the improved circuit by switching. Finally, the three calculation methods are verified by simulation, and compared with the actual resistance value of the DC system, and the test results prove the effectiveness of the improved method.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on CEEMDAN-Bi-LSTM Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Accurately predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) is crucial for maintaining the stable operation of equipment, yet it remains a challenging task. Capacity regeneration phenomena can lead to inaccurate RUL predictions. To address this, this paper proposes a prediction method using a CEEMDAN-Bi-LSTM hybrid model. Initially, multiple health features are extracted from charging variation curves. To mitigate the effects of capacity regeneration, the complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise is applied to decompose the HFs. Subsequently, a bidirectional long short-term memory neural network is introduced to construct the CEEMDAN-Bi-LSTM hybrid model for RUL prediction of lithium batteries. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified using NASA experimental data by comparing it with several other models. The results demonstrate that the proposed model can significantly enhance the prediction accuracy of lithium-ion battery RUL.

Author Keywords: complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise
bidirectional long short-term memory neural network

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Training in Power Information Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence technology, large language models possess more precise semantic understanding capabilities and stronger intent comprehension abilities, providing solid technical support for intelligent training in power information communication. This article first introduces the feasibility and significance of applying intelligent training in power communication, and then conducts research on the system architecture of the intelligent training system for power information communication. Finally, an intelligent training system for power information communication is established, which changes the current training status through the application of intelligent training in power information communication, making the training more efficient and targeted.

articleTitle: A New LSTM Based Method for Predicting Heat Pump Air Flow
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In order to address the challenges posed by climate change and global warming, air source heat pumps, as a green and energy-saving technology, are becoming increasingly popular in building space heating. The real-time frosting problem in the air source heat pump heating mode has not been accurately identified, resulting in problems such as delayed defrosting and unclean defrosting. This article is based on the method of long and short-term memory neural networks, analyzing the relevant principles of the frost process. Using neural network models and relevant data collected in the laboratory, the important variables required for the frost model, namely the real-time air volume value of the outdoor unit, are predicted. The test results show that the established air volume prediction model can accurately reflect the real-time air volume value of the next node, with a MAPE value within 3%, achieving relatively accurate early prediction.

Author Keywords: long and short-term memory neural networks

articleTitle: Method for Detecting Defects in Power Transmission Lines Based on an Improved YOLOv8 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Intelligent inspection of power transmission lines plays a crucial role in ensuring the stable operation of the power grid. In response to the challenges of lacking dynamic and intelligent inspection technologies for transmission lines, this paper proposes a method for detecting defects in power transmission lines based on an improved YOLOv8 algorithm. The method incorporates the Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) to enhance the model's multi-scale feature fusion and expressive capabilities, thereby improving the accuracy of detecting small targets. Simultaneously, the C2f module is replaced with a lightweight C3Ghost module, which maintains feature extraction capabilities while reducing the model's complexity and lowering the computational costs on the edge. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved model significantly reduces computational demands by 19.5% compared to the baseline model while enhancing the mAP50, Precision, and Recall metrics. The enhanced algorithm increases the accuracy of defect detection in power transmission lines. It significantly reduces the model's complexity, making it more suitable for deployment on terminal devices such as drones. This provides technical support for the digital transformation of the power grid.

Author Keywords: intelligent inspection of power transmission lines

articleTitle: An Integrated Learning Carbon Emission Prediction Algorithm Optimized for Stacking Based On Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the proposed “double carbon” goal, it is of great practical significance to forecast the carbon emission of energy industry. This paper presents a carbon emission prediction method based on genetic algorithm and integrated Stacking learning to resolve the limitations of existing methods.In this paper, key factors such as fossil raw material consumption and electricity consumption in the production process are first collected to fill in the missing values of the data, and then standardized. On this basis, the corrected data set is divided into k parts for K-folding cross-validation. Furthermore, the integrated learning model is constructed. The minimum output error of the Stacking model is taken as the fitness function, and the hyperparameters of the Stacking learner model are optimized by genetic algorithm. Finally, the optimized model hyperparameters are substituted into the Stacking to obtain the finally trained models. The combined model proposed in this paper makes full use of the advantages of a single model and further improves the accuracy of carbon emission prediction in the steel industry.

articleTitle: Virtual Impedance-Based Reactive Power Sharing Strategy with Enhanced Voltage Quality for Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In the islanded microgrids, the mismatch of line impedance can lead to an inaccurate distribution of reactive power, and the traditional virtual impedance control strategies may result in substantial bus voltage degradation. In this paper, a minimum-oriented adaptive virtual impedance (MAVI) control strategy is proposed to solve this problems. Firstly, by estimating the line impedance and combining the distributed algorithm to compare the impedance information between distributed generation (DG) units, the virtual inductance of each DG unit is synchronized to the minimum value under the condition of accurate reactive power sharing, so the bus voltage drop caused by the virtual inductance is further reduced. Secondly, the resistive component of the feeder is decreased by adjusting the virtual resistor to reduce the coupling between active and reactive power. Furthermore, the frequency response of the virtual resistor is also enhanced by a proportional resonant controller, reducing its damping impact at the fundamental frequency and thereby increasing the system's stability. The effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by the simulation of an islanded microgrid with four DGs.

articleTitle: Output Current Balancing Control Strategy of Energy Storage Units Based on Improved Consensus Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: A control strategy based on an improved consensus algorithm for balancing the output current of energy storage units in isolated DC microgrids, considering differences in the line impedance of storage units, is proposed. A timing convergence improved consensus algorithm is introduced, which can achieve convergence within a specified time, thereby enhancing the convergence speed compared to traditional consensus algorithms. The timing convergence consensus algorithm is combined with droop control to ensure bus voltage stability in isolated DC microgrids. The impact of different operating conditions on the output current balance of energy storage units is analyzed by MATLAB/Simulink, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Bad Data Identification Method for Medium Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Bad data identification is an essential prerequisite for state estimation in distribution networks. When multiple leverage measurements with bad data occur in the system, traditional residual-based methods are ineffective in identifying bad data, leading to potential misjudgments and missed detections. Additionally, traditional mixed-integer nonlinear programming methods for solving this issue suffer from low efficiency due to the large number of integer variables and nonlinear constraints in the model. Therefore, a bad data identification method based on mixed-integer linear programming is proposed. By employing the data-physical fusion-driven linearization method for linearization, a mixed- integer linear programming-based bad data identification model is constructed. Case studies demonstrate that the bad data identification method based on mixed-integer linear programming can significantly improve solution efficiency while ensuring accuracy in identification.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Carbon Accounting Information System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper explores the application of blockchain technology in carbon accounting information systems to enhance the security and trustworthiness of carbon emission data management. We introduce the significance of carbon accounting information systems and their challenges., analyze the potential advantages of blockchain technology in carbon emission data management., and discuss the crucial role of data encryption technology in ensuring the security and trustworthiness of carbon emission data. We construct the traceability and supervision of carbon emission data, the application of smart contracts in carbon trading, and the mathematical definition and model of data encryption technology to ensure the trustworthiness of carbon emission data. Through quantitative analysis, we provide a theoretical foundation for addressing carbon emission data's security and trustworthiness issues. Finally, we design and implement the application of blockchain technology in carbon accounting information systems using Python pseudo-code. This paper provides practical technical solutions for the information construction of carbon markets and the security management of carbon emission data. It makes contributions to the construction of theoretical definitions and mathematical models.

articleTitle: A Novel Infrared Image Segmentation Algorithm for Substation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach utilizing two-dimensional (2D) multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis (MF-DFA) to pinpoint areas of singularity within infrared images of substation equipment. Our method involves the computation of the local generalized Hurst exponent, through 2D MF-DFA. Initially, we compute the generalized Hurst exponent for each pixel, followed by the derivation of the box-counting dimension based on the generalized Hurst exponent values of select pixels. Subsequently, we utilize the results to extract edge regions from the images. We conduct various numerical experiments. Firstly, we validate the effectiveness and basic principles of the algorithm proposed in this paper using a simple two-dimensional image. Then, experiments are conducted on infrared images of both simple and complex substation equipment. The results indicate that our method can effectively segment substation equipment in the infrared images of substations with varying degrees of complexity.

articleTitle: Flexible Resource Virtual Power Plant Aggregation Scheduling Method Considering Uncertainty and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In order to find a high-quality method to improve the Overall adjustable capability of VPP and the accuracy of the aggregation model, this paper proposes the management and interaction mechanism of VPP for flexible resources. Considering the demand response of the power side and the uncertainty of the power generation side, an aggregation model including power baseline, robust rolling optimization equivalent model and cost curve is established by taking into account the uncertainty and demand response of the aggregation method, and establishes an aggregation model including power baseline, robust rolling optimization equivalence model and cost curve to realize the regulation of The aggregation model including power baseline, robust rolling optimization equivalence model and cost curve is established to achieve efficient and orderly grid connection and coordinated regulation of flexible resources, which improves the flexibility and accuracy of VPP participation in regulation. Finally, according to the simulation analysis, it is proved that the proposed aggregation model can effectively obtain the external characteristics of VPP and give full play to the flexibility of flexible resources.

articleTitle: A Self-Interpretable Deep Learning Soft Sensor Based on Spatio-Temporal Causal Discovery Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: As the complexity of industrial system and process data increases, deep learning has demonstrated performance beyond traditional methods in the soft sensor domain. However, deep learning's black-box design restricts the models' interpretability, which could produce inaccurate prediction outcomes. Using a temporal attention mechanism and a gated recurrent unit, this study presents a novel spatio-temporal self-interpretative causal discovery (STCD) model that resolves this problem by generating a self-interpretative soft sensor that can identify spatio-temporal causality in time-series data. By minimizing the maximum mean difference loss function, the model can simulate the distribution of real data and improve the prediction accuracy. Using real industrial data, spatio-temporal causality maps were constructed and the model learning results were analyzed to determine the spatio-temporal causality between variables. The direction of spatio-temporal causality was determined by comparing the effective model complexity, and a spatio-temporal causal directed graph was plotted while generating soft sensors to visualize the relationship between variables. The application to a rotating air pre-heater thermal deformation dataset verifies the validity of the self-interpretation capability of the STCD method, which offers advantages in terms of performance and causal resolution capability over existing soft sensor and causal discovery methods. This work not only provides a new soft sensor approach for understanding and predicting time series data, but also provides new insights for exploring causal mechanisms between variables in industrial processes.

articleTitle: Non Intrusive Load Monitoring of Energy Routers Based on FHMM
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Having the ability to perceive load information is a necessary requirement for the effective operation of home energy routers. In order to improve the load intelligent sensing technology for home energy routers, this article uses non-invasive load monitoring technology to achieve the load intelligent sensing function of home energy routers. Non- intrusive load monitoring, as an energy consumption monitoring method, can deeply analyze the fine-grained load components of users, which is of great significance for power optimization at the user end. At the same time, it also has the characteristics of fast implementation and low cost. Firstly, establish a system model for non-invasive load monitoring of energy routers, then establish a non-invasive load monitoring model based on FHMM. Finally, use the Viterbi algorithm to solve for the optimal hidden state sequence of load devices, and then calculate the power consumption of each device. The experimental results show that the decomposition results of the proposed algorithm are close to the actual load.

articleTitle: Digital Twin for Smart Grid: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The synthesis of digital twin (DT) technology into smart grid systems has emerged as a promising approach for enhancing operational efficiency, reliability, and resilience in en-ergy management. DTs offer a virtual representation of physical assets and processes, enabling real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, optimization, and control. This survey paper provides an overview of the recent advances in designing DTs to upgrade the smart grid. We mainly focus on aspects of DT concept, DT empowered economic dispatch, DT empowered prediction and diagnosis, and DT empowered frequency and voltage regulations. Finally, we pinpoint potential challenges and conclude this paper.

articleTitle: Research on the regional integrated energy optimization operation of CCS and hydrogen energy utilization system under stepped carbon trading
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Driven by the national dual-carbon policy, the goal of reducing carbon emissions has become the main task facing us now. First of all, combined with the integrated demand response strategy, the model considers the carbon capture system combined with the hydrogen energy utilization system as the main framework of clean and low-carbon technology. At the same time, in order to improve the low-carbon nature, an appropriate proportion of hydrogen is blended into the fuel of combined heat and power units and gas boilers. Secondly, in order to reasonably meet the requirements of reducing carbon emissions, the fixed carbon emission coefficients in the actual carbon emission model take into account the effects of the unit load rate and the fuel hydrogen doping rate, and the dynamic carbon emission coefficient model is constructed based on the entropy weighting method, which can be used to account for the carbon emissions more accurately. Finally, the simulation is carried out by combining the uncertainty on both sides of the source load with robust decision theory. The simulation of the arithmetic example verifies the economic and low-carbon nature of the developed model and its ability to reduce the amount of wind abandonment.

articleTitle: Neuron-Level Control Based on Multi-Frequency Policy Dissection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Neuron-level control is an effective approach to enhancing the intrinsic decision-making capabilities of reinforcement learning models, obviating additional model training, as well as the need to modify reward functions. However, existing neuron-level control algorithms are difficult to be widely applied due to poor control performance, which is potentially attributed to the use of a single DC signal when overwriting the hidden states of neurons. To achieve high-performance neuron-level control, this study proposes the Multi-frequency Policy Dissection (MPD). MPD firstly identifies the neuron most relevant to each kinematic attribute by considering all frequency components within the temporal signals of both the neuronal hidden states and kinematic attributes comprehensively. Then MPD uses mixed signals containing multiple main frequency components to overwrite the hidden states of the identified neurons to achieve the desired agent behaviors. Compared with the state-of-the-art neuron-level control algorithm, MPD exhibits significant advantages across various evaluation metrics and unlocks complex behaviors in the bipedal robot. Furthermore, we visualize the correlation between the kinematic attributes and the hidden states of the matched neurons, and explore the gradual establishment of this correlation during the model training.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Question and Answer Reasoning Algorithm Based on Natural Language Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of artificial intelligence technology, intelligent Q&A systems have become one of the most important ways for people to obtain information. However, traditional Q&A systems retrieve answers only through keyword matching and are unable to perform deep semantic understanding and reasoning, thus affecting the accuracy and reliability of the system. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent Q&A reasoning algorithm based on natural language processing technology, aiming to improve the Q&A capability of the system. This paper focuses on the application of intelligent Q&A reasoning algorithm based on natural language processing technology in the field of intelligent training for power information communication. An intelligent Q&A reasoning algorithm is designed by combining neural network technology. The experimental results show that the algorithm performs well in entity extraction and entity-relationship graph design, and achieves good accuracy in question-answer reasoning. The algorithm has the potential and advantage of providing an efficient and intelligent solution for intelligent training in power information and communication.

Author Keywords: intelligent question and answer;power Information Communication Intelligence Training

articleTitle: A Study on Carbon Emission Prediction Model in Ceramic Industry Based on CNN-BiLSTM-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Against the backdrop of global efforts to promote low-carbon development, the ceramic industry faces pressure to enhance energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions. This paper proposes a combined model algorithm integrating Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network (BiLSTM), and attention mechanism, aiming to improve the accuracy of carbon emission prediction in the ceramic industry. The study first normalizes carbon emission-related data in the ceramic industry to eliminate the influence of different dimensions, focusing on three main features: net purchased electricity, comprehensive energy consumption per unit product, and electricity emissions as a proportion of total emissions. CNN is employed to extract spatio-temporal local patterns of these features, BiLSTM captures the long-term dependency relationships of time series, and the attention mechanism weights the model's inputs, enhancing its ability to capture key information. Experiments conducted on real carbon emission data from a series of ceramic enterprises demonstrate that the proposed CNN-BiLSTM-Attention combined model significantly outperforms traditional prediction methods across multiple evaluation metrics. This achievement not only improves the accuracy of carbon emission prediction in the ceramic industry but also provides robust data support for enterprises to formulate more scientific carbon reduction strategies, thus contributing to the sustainable development of the ceramic industry.

articleTitle: Research Progress and Prospects of Heat Storage Water Tanks and Parameter Adjustment in Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The heat storage water tank is an important equipment in the energy storage system. How to fully utilize the heat storage and heat release functions of the heat storage water tank and maximize its performance in the entire energy storage systems has always been a concern in the fields of technology and industry. Especially in the current situation of low-carbon, environmental protection, energy conservation and emission reduction, how to improve the maximum efficiency of energy storage system in the energy internet and heating system will be an important link to improve the productivity of the whole process. Therefore, this article reviews the external shape, internal structure, thermal stratification characteristics of heat storage tanks, and the operating parameter adjustment, and summarizes the current research progress of heat storage tank technology, and looks forward to the research propects on heat storage tank technology.

articleTitle: Temperature Rise-Aware Compensation Control for Active Magnetic Suspension Bearing System Based on Neural Network Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Significant temperature rise can lead to parameter variations in the rotor of magnetic levitation bearings and cause thermal drift in eddy current sensors, thereby affecting the stability of active magnetic suspension systems. To enhance the stability of magnetic suspension systems under high-temperature conditions, a temperature compensation control method based on neural network identification is proposed. Firstly, a linearized magnetic force model of active magnetic bearings and a single-degree-of-freedom axial magnetic levitation rotor system model are established to analyze the influence of temperature on the stiffness parameters of magnetic suspension rotors, power amplifiers, and displacement sensor amplification gains. Secondly, an offline identification method using neural networks is adopted to identify the resistance values of the stator coil and the probe coil of the eddy current sensor under different temperature conditions. Then, based on the identified resistance values, a temperature rise compensation control scheme for the active magnetic suspension system is designed using a combination of series and parallel compensation. Finally, through Simulink simulationand experimentation, it is demonstrated that the temperature compensation control method based on neural network identification can improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: A Distributed PV Voltage Control Method based on RL and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper investigates the limitations of traditional reactive voltage control methods in the context of distributed new energy integration, especially in scenarios involving reactive voltage control with photovoltaic inverters. Given the deficiencies in model dependency and solution speed, the paper adopts an interactive multi-agent deep reinforcement learning approach to learn reactive voltage control strategies for photovoltaics, making improvements and designs for different issues within the distribution network system and algorithm. Key contributions include: using a centralized training decentralized execution (CTDE) framework among multi-agents to optimize the balance between communication cost and control effectiveness; distinguishing between global rewards and local rewards to optimize the overall cost of the grid and voltage control at photovoltaic grid connection points, and enhancing the visualization and interpretability of the multi-agent algorithm through the introduction of an attention mechanism, which also visualizes the importance of contributions from different agents during the voltage optimization control process.

articleTitle: Mixed Game Based Multi-Virtual Power Plant with Distribution Network Optimization Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This paper study the cooperative management of multiple virtual power plants (VPPs) within the same distribution network. The objective is to orchestrate the scheduling of units, facilitate energy trading between peers within the VPP alliance. This is achieved by establishing electricity pricing via the distribution system operator (DSO). Additionally, shared energy storage is introduced within the VPP alliance to reduce the primary investment cost of energy storage. This paper proposes an optimization model based on a mixed game, which constructs both a Stackelberg game between the DSO and VPP alliance and a cooperation game among VPPs. Based on Nash Bargaining theory, the VPP alliance model is equated into two subproblems: maximizing alliance revenue and distributing cooperative revenue. The proposed model is solved by combining the dichotomous distributed optimization algorithm and the alternating directional multiplier method (ADMM). The simulation results confirm the practicality and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Key Parameters Prediction for Intelligent Control and Energy Optimization Based on MIC-BWO-XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In the aviation industry, anodic oxidation serves as a core process for surface modification of aluminum alloy components, albeit accompanied by high energy consumption. Accurate prediction of key parameters can offer decision support for the intelligent control and energy optimization of anodic oxidation. However, the limited sample size resulting from the high cost of data collection and the complex nonlinear patterns caused by the synergy of multiple factors pose a challenge in accurately predicting key parameters. Therefore, we propose a key parameters prediction method based on the Maximum Information Coefficient (MIC), Beluga Whale Optimization algorithm (BWO), and XGBoost algorithm. Considering the adverse impact of low correlation parameters on prediction accuracy, we first use MIC to extract features from the original data. Then, XGBoost is used to integrate multiple decision trees to ensure the strong fitting ability for nonlinear relationships. Compared to deep learning models, XGBoost performs well even in a limited sample size. In addition, considering XGBoost is prone to overfitting training data as an ensemble learning algorithm, we employ the BWO to optimize four key parameters of the model that are difficult to choose, thereby enhancing model's generalization. The model's performance is evaluated using Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), with values of 0.04388, 0.09410, and 0.20730%, respectively. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms traditional approaches, enabling precise prediction of key parameters and holding significant value for the intelligent control and energy optimization of anode oxidation processes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Brazil's 8·15 Major Power Outage Accident and its Implications for Liaoning Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: On August 15, 2023, due to a series of chain reactions after the 500 kV line reclosing accidental tripping action, a large-scale power outage occurred in the Brazilian power grid. The Brazilian power grid was divided into the northern power grid, the northeastern power grid, and the southeast-south-central power grid. The three parts of the Western Power Grid, 25 Brazilian states and the federal district of Brasilia, the capital, were all affected to varying degrees, with a total load loss of 22.55 million kilowatts, accounting for approximately 31% of the total load. The article introduces the operation of the Brazilian power grid before the accident, as well as the cause, process, recovery and consequences of the accident. It points out that the main reasons for the accident are weak grid structure, insufficient power support, imperfect technical defense lines, and shortcomings in safety management and control. The reasons, combined with the actual situation of Liaoning Power Grid, put forward the suggestions of paying close attention to the “six enhancements” and doing a good job in the “six preventions” to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Advancing Power Load Forecasting Framework with CNN-GRU-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In the realm of power system operations, accurate load forecasting is paramount for effective planning and scheduling. Traditional models, however, struggle to adapt to the evolving complexity of power load structures. Addressing this gap, we introduce a novel load forecasting methodology employing a fusion model that integrates Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM). This model adeptly accounts for the variability in meteorological and temporal factors, thereby enhancing forecasting precision. Additionally, we implement a “rolling aggregation-variance detection” algorithm for analyzing power surge scenarios across diverse industries. Our approach not only elevates the accuracy of load predictions but also serves as a robust technical foundation for future power system load forecasting endeavors.

articleTitle: Research on Power Transformer Fault Diagnosis Based on Experience and Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low output security of pure data model in power transformer fault diagnosis, this paper proposes an empirical data dual-driven power transformer fault diagnosis model. The model defines the empirical function and calculation rules for transformer fault diagnosis, and combines the empirical model of IEC three-ratio value in the field of transformer diagnosis and the IPSO-PNN data model to obtain the empirical and data-driven dualdiagnostic model. In the data model, the parameters of the PNN are optimized using an improved particle swarm algorithm, in which the standard particle swarm algorithm is improved by introducing Circle chaotic mapping, adaptive weight coefficients, and Cauchy's variational perturbation strategy, which improves the generalization ability and correctness of the classification of the PNN. Examples show that the empirical data dual model proposed in this paper improves the overall correct rate by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4.76{{\%}}$</tex> compared to the IPSO-PNN data-driven model, reduces the error rate of misclassifying faulty states as nonfaulty states by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$6.35{{\%}}$</tex>, and improves the safety of the fault diagnosis output results.

articleTitle: Self-Balancing and Self-Optimization Oriented Source-Grid-Storage Collaborative Planning Method for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Under the background of the current new power system, the distribution network with large-scale distributed photovoltaic integration faces serious power quality issues. Current planning schemes aimed at self-balancing and selfoptimization distribution networks typically only consider single factors, such as reactive power compensation or energy storage planning. In practical engineering, however, a comprehensive approach is needed, which includes considerations of network restructuring, line modifications, addition of reactive power voltage regulation devices, and energy storage, among other measures. Therefore, a comprehensive planning model has been established that takes into account these factors. To enhance the computational efficiency of this planning model, a hybrid dataphysical-driven approach is adopted to linear modelling of the power flow constraints, significantly improving computational efficiency while ensuring computational accuracy meets engineering requirements. This proposed method has been applied in practical engineering projects and validated based on actual engineering cases, demonstrating the effectiveness of the comprehensive planning model.

articleTitle: Nonparametric End-to-End Probabilistic Forecasting of Distributed Generation Outputs Considering Missing Data Imputation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a nonparametric end-to-end method for probabilistic forecasting of distributed renewable generation outputs while including missing data imputation. Firstly, we employ a nonparametric probabilistic forecast model utilizing the long short-term memory (LSTM) network to model the probability distributions of distributed renewable generations' outputs. Secondly, we design an end-to-end training process that includes missing data imputation through iterative imputation and iterative loss-based training procedures. This two-step modeling approach effectively combines the strengths of the nonparametric method with the end-to-end approach. Consequently, our approach demonstrates exceptional capabilities in probabilistic forecasting for the outputs of distributed renewable generations while effectively handling missing values. Simulation results confirm the superior performance of our approach compared to existing alternatives.

articleTitle: Research on Pseudo Measurement Generation Method Based on 1D-CNN and Transfer Learning for Medium-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of new power systems, ensuring the safe and optimized operation of distribution networks becomes particularly important. Due to constraints such as economic factors, the comprehensive deployment of real-time measurement devices in mediumvoltage distribution networks faces significant challenges, resulting in insufficient observability of the distribution network. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method that combines one-dimensional convolutional neural networks (1D-CNN) with transfer learning for pseudo measurement generation. This method first constructs a 1D-CNN pseudo measurement generation model using a large amount of historical measurement data, and then trains and optimizes the 1D-CNN model through transfer learning to achieve pseudo measurement generation even under topological changes. The test results of actual engineering data demonstrate that the proposed method can generate high-frequency pseudo measurement data for nodes in medium-voltage distribution networks in real time, accurately, and efficiently. Additionally, the proposed method exhibits good adaptability when the distribution network topology changes. In this way, this paper provides a new technical path for the perception of the operational status of medium-voltage distribution networks and provides technical support for the safe and optimized operation of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Monitoring Approach for Energy Storage Systems in Smart Grids Based on Dual-Layer Networks and Sample Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Non-intrusive monitoring of energy storage involves calculating the state, as well as the charging and discharging power, of each energy storage unit by disaggregating the total energy storage signal of the entire mini-grid. Efficient and accurate identification of the charging and discharging states and powers of individual energy storage units can enhance the distribution efficiency and energy conservation of smart grids. Current approaches primarily focus on developing distinct models for each device, leading to high computational complexity and dependence on high-quality labeled samples. This paper proposes a two-layer multitasking network structure to predict the charging and discharging power of each energy storage device while simultaneously classifying the device states within the mini-grid. Furthermore, a sample enhancement strategy is introduced to utilize self-augmented samples during training, thereby improving the classification accuracy and generalization of the model. To enhance spatio-temporal information, a spatio-temporal attention mechanism is proposed, combining the multi-head attention mechanism with sine-cosine position coding. Simulation results demonstrate that the method presented in this paper significantly enhances accuracy compared to previous non-intrusive detection methods and exhibits robust generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: Estimate-Based Output Feedback Stabilization of a Class of Nonlinear Systems Against DoS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: In this paper, the global stabilization of networked control systems experiencing nonlinear uncertainty and suscep-tible to denial-of-service (DoS) attacks is demonstrated. This stabilization is achieved through the utilization of a resilient event-triggering mechanism operating under extended triangular linear growth conditions, employing feedback control techniques with discrete-time output feedback controllers and discrete-time resilient event-triggering conditions. The relationship between the inactivity/activity period of DoS attacks, resilient event-triggering mechanism (RETM) parameters, non-measurable states and sampling period in the model is also quantitatively discussed. Since the observer and controller of this controller are discrete, it can be easily implemented by computer. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an examples.

articleTitle: A Community Energy Management Method Based on Explainable Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The construction industry is responsible for a substantial portion of final energy consumption (36%) and carbon dioxide emissions (39%), and this share is likely to rise as urbanization increases. This paper presents this model, which is based on HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) systems. Utilizing reinforcement learning (RL), one can ascertain the most efficient strategy to reduce HVAC energy usage while ensuring the thermal comfort of inhabitants. Because neural networks are complex and unpredictable, which impede the broad acceptance of artificial intelligence in the power industry. Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) is used to explain the decision-making process in deep reinforcement learning, HVAC systems are major energy users in buildings, and the switch to mixed ventilation modes has resulted in a more than 40% decrease in cooling device energy usage when compared to traditional methods. The energy transfer dynamics within HVAC systems can be delineated as a Markov Decision Process, with the objective of making informed choices across various states to maximize long-term benefits. The exploration of agents’ behavioral policies can be enabled through the utilization of the Multi Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient algorithm (MADDPG).
