Experimental findings indicate that the RL-driven HVAC energy management approach is adept at adapting to diverse environmental conditions, effectively curbing energy usage, and enhancing comfort levels compared to conventional optimization control strategies.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Planning Approach Considering Mobile Energy Storage Vehicles to Enhance System Self Optimization Ability
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Traditional distribution network planning usually first plans and then checks the self-approximate optimization ability. It is difficult to feed back the self-approximate optimization ability check results to effectively correct the grid planning scheme. Therefore, it is necessary to establish a planning method considering the self-approximate optimization ability of the distribution network. With the development of distribution network, mobile and fixed energy storage is widely used. Through the optimal configuration of multiple types of energy storage, the power supply of key loads can be maintained when faults occur, and the self-approximate optimization ability of urban distribution network can be improved. Therefore, this paper first adopts an analytical expression method of self-approximate optimization ability index based on fault timing logic. And embeds the self-approximate optimization ability index constraint into the traditional distribution network planning model. Then, an improved distribution network planning model is established by considering the fault timing logic of mobile energy storage vehicles and fixed energy storage participating in the restoration of the power supply in the operation constraints. The model realises the distribution network planning considering the influence of mobile and fixed energy storage on self-optimisation ability, which can be solved by a mixed integer linear programming solver. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is proved by a 24-node actual distribution network example.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch for the Energy Internet: A Review of Progress, Challenges and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: This dissertation focuses on the development of the Energy Internet, its key issues, and future trends for optimal scheduling. With the growth of global energy demand and advancements in renewable energy technology, the Energy Internet is gradually emerging as an advanced energy utilization system. It reconfigures the traditional energy system through the deep integration of energy, information, and intelligent technologies, realizing the efficient synergy of multiple energy sources, the interaction between supply and demand, and the balance between distributed and centralized resources. The core of the Energy Internet lies in the realization of two-way flow and peer-to-peer exchange of energy, enabling energy to be flexibly transmitted and shared between different nodes. The paper presents the key issues of optimal dispatch and offers an outlook on the future development trends, aiming to provide a reference for energy transition and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Optimal Dispatching of Integrated Energy System Based on Ultra-supercritical Units
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Currently, the power industry is still dominated by traditional coal-fired thermal power units. Ultra-supercritical (UCS) units are widely used in most areas of my country due to their large installed capacity and high cycle thermal efficiency. However, it produces large carbon emissions during the power generation process and fails to meet the demand for diversified energy sources in some regions. Therefore, this article combines ultra-supercritical units with integrated energy systems and proposes three solutions. Firstly, mathematical modeling of various equipment is performed. Secondly, carbon tax is taken into account when optimizing the equipment capacity of the integrated energy system. Finally, the heuristic algorithm in the Gurobi solver is used to find the optimal solution, and the three proposed solutions are evaluated using economic efficiency and carbon emissions as indicators. The results show that the proposed scheme can meet diversified energy needs. The scheme of adding gas boilers and absorption heat pumps has the lowest total annual cost. The scheme of adding gas boilers, absorption heat pumps, electric energy storage, thermal energy storage, and cold energy storage devices has the lowest total annual cost. Annual carbon dioxide emissions are minimal. Compared with the initial plan, the annual total cost of the optimal plan can be reduced by 27.93 million yuan, and the annual carbon dioxide emissions can be reduced by 106,500 tons.

articleTitle: A Credible Capacity Assessment Method for New Energy Sources Based on Time Series Stochastic Production Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: For the new power system, this paper proposes a new energy trusted capacity evaluation method based on time series stochastic production simulation. The multi-state probability model of conventional units and energy storage is established by using the multi-state analysis method under the scheduling strategy considering energy storage. Based on the established sequential stochastic production simulation model, dichotomy is used to calculate the trusted capacity of new energy iteratively. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by analyzing a practical example in a certain region.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Monitoring Method Based on UNet for Operating Status of Distributed Energy Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Traditional non-intrusive monitoring methods usually rely on a single model or basic algorithm, making it difficult to accurately implement complex state data analysis and condition monitoring. Therefore, the article proposes an advanced monitoring architecture based on Multi-UNet to optimize non-intrusive operating status monitoring. First, by integrating encoders and multi-layer perceptrons, the feature space is significantly expanded and the network's ability to process complex state data is improved. Then, the attention mechanism is used to effectively enhance the fusion of state features and power features in the state identification stage, allowing the model to more accurately consider state information when performing power decomposition. In addition, quantile regression and multilabel learning methods are applied to further optimize the power decomposition process, which not only improves the efficiency of power decomposition, but also increases the accuracy of the overall monitoring system. Finally, an experimental case is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A New Positioning Approach of Pipeline Passing Ball based on Vibration Signal with Short-term Energy Zero Feature
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The detector in the pipeline plays an important role in ensuring the transportation safety of the oil pipeline. However, due to the closed and complicated internal environment of the pipeline, it is difficult to accurately control the position of the detection device after it is put into operation. Therefore, it is necessary to use the marking system to determine the precise time when the detection device passes through the marking point and record its operation position and corresponding pipeline section. A method of pipeline positioning system based on vibration signal with short-term energy and zero characteristics is proposed. In this method, two sensors are used to collect the friction vibration signals between the through-the-ball detection equipment and the pipe wall, and the signal noise is reduced by improving the empirical mode decomposition method. According to the vibration waveform and the time delay of two signals, the classification method of vibration signals and the prediction scheme of passing time are designed to realize the passing positioning of detection equipment.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Method of Electricity-Hydrogen Hybrid Energy Storage Microgrid System Based on Business Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Promoting the low-carbon transformation of microgrids is an important means to achieve the dual carbon goals. to solve the problem of optimal scheduling of electricity-hydrogen hybrid energy storage microgrids under different business models, firstly, the mathematical model of electricity-hydrogen hybrid energy storage microgrids is established, secondly, the typical business model of multi-party cooperative energy supply is summarized, and the multi-objective optimal scheduling model and constraints based on the above business models are constructed and analyze and discuss the advantages and disadvantages of typical business models. articleTitle: Data Security Transmission and Privacy Protection Scheme for Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Industrial Internet of Things, a vast amount of data generates, collects, and processes, playing a crucial role in industrial production and operations. Addressing issues of privacy leakage, identity forgery, and data security during data transmission in IIoT, this paper proposes a data security transmission and privacy protection scheme based on blockchain technology. The scheme employs zero-knowledge proof algorithms for identity authentication of terminal devices to ensure the privacy of device information is not compromised, effectively preventing identity forgery and attacks. Additionally, it uses attribute-based encryption to secure the data's confidentiality. To ensure efficient data storage and the security of encryption keys, the scheme utilizes IPFS for on-chain querying and off-chain storage of data. The security of the proposed scheme is analyzed theoretically, and its computational overhead is evaluated experimentally. The results show that this scheme has lower computational overhead compared to other schemes, while significantly enhancing security and reliability.

articleTitle: Power Grid Topology Regulation Method Based on Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: The effective control of power grid is challenged by the increasing integration proportion of renewable energy which leads to the growing complexity, even instability in power grid. To solve this, this study proposes a power grid topology regulation method based on hierarchical reinforcement learning. By expanding the Actor-Critic model in reinforcement learning into a hierarchical structure, the upper-layer generates an ideal power grid topology configuration based on the current power grid environment, while the lower-layer only needs to be responsible for generating strategies on how to achieve this goal. Compared with existing methods, this process eliminates the numerous intermediate states and superfluous actions, and therefore alleviates the sparse rewards and high-dimensional action and state space problems of reinforcement learning. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can enhance power grid operation by reducing uniformity and decreasing power loss, achieving a safer and more stable operation of the power grid. Finally, the effectiveness of the hierarchical model is confirmed through ablation experiments. Additionally, challenges in practical application and future development directions for the method are discussed.

articleTitle: Overview of Vehicle-to-Grid Participation in Market Services
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Cyber-Energy Systems and Intelligent Energy (ICCSIE)
abstract: Under the guidance of the dual-carbon strategic goal, the number of electric vehicles in China has grown rapidly and the penetration rate of the charging load has increased rapidly. Guidance for the load of electric vehicles to respond to the demand for regulation of the power grid can greatly alleviate the impact of disorderly charging and discharging of electric vehicles in the power system. At the same time, it can effectively stimulate the value of mobile energy storage of electric vehicles and provide abundant stock flexibility resources for the new power system. By systematically combing the relevant literature on vehicle network interaction and participation in market services, it provides a reference and reference for the optimal regulation of electric vehicles in the future. The current situation of electric vehicle load aggregation participating in electricity market transactions is described. The electric vehicle load aggregation trading strategy is summarized. The electric vehicle aggregation optimization scheduling method is introduced. This article summarizes the existing research, points out the shortcomings, and looks forward to the future direction of the research.
